edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Maecenas atavis edite regibus,</l>

lines.text: o et praesidium et dulce decus meum:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">o et praesidium et dulce decus meum:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">sunt quos curriculo pulverem Olympicum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">collegisse iuvat metaque fervidis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">evitata rotis palmaque nobilis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">terrarum dominos evehit ad deos;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">hunc, si mobilium turba Quiritium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">certat tergeminis tollere honoribus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">illum, si proprio condidit horreo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">quidquid de Libycis verritur areis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">gaudentem patrios findere sarculo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">agros Attalicis condicionibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">numquam demoveas, ut trabe Cypria</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">Myrtoum pavidus nauta secet mare.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">luctantem Icariis fluctibus Africum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">mercator metuens otium et oppidi</l>

lines.text: laudat rura sui; mox reficit rates
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">laudat rura sui; mox reficit rates</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">quassas indocilis pauperiem pati.</l>

lines.text: est qui nec veteris pocula Massici
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">est qui nec veteris pocula Massici</l>

lines.text: nec partem solido demere de die
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">nec partem solido demere de die</l>

lines.text: spernit, nunc viridi membra sub arbuto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">spernit, nunc viridi membra sub arbuto</l>

lines.text: stratus, nunc ad aquae lene caput sacrae.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">stratus, nunc ad aquae lene caput sacrae.</l>

lines.text: multos castra iuvant et lituo tubae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">multos castra iuvant et lituo tubae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">permixtus sonitus bellaque matribus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">detestata. manet sub Iove frigido</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">venator tenerae coniugis inmemor,</l>

lines.text: seu visa est catulis cerva fidelibus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">seu visa est catulis cerva fidelibus</l>

lines.text: seu rupit teretes Marsus aper plagas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">seu rupit teretes Marsus aper plagas.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">me doctarum hederae praemia frontium</l>

lines.text: dis miscent superis, me gelidum nemus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">dis miscent superis, me gelidum nemus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">Nympharumque leves cum Satyris chori</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">secernunt populo, si neque tibias</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">Euterpe cohibet nec Polyhymnia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">Lesboum refugit tendere barbiton.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">quodsi me lyricis vatibus inseres,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">sublimi feriam sidera vertice.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Iam satis terris nivis atque dirae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Iam satis terris nivis atque dirae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">grandinis misit pater et rubente</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">dextera sacras iaculatus arcis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">terruit urbem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">terruit gentis, grave ne rediret</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">saeculum Pyrrhae nova monstra questae,</l>

lines.text: omne cum Proteus pecus egit altos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">omne cum Proteus pecus egit altos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">visere montis,</l>

lines.text: piscium et summa genus haesit ulmo,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">piscium et summa genus haesit ulmo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">nota quae sedes fuerat columbis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">et superiecto pavidae natarunt</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">aequore dammae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">vidimus flavum Tiberim retortis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">litore Etrusco violenter undis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">ire deiectum monumenta regis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">templaque Vestae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">Iliae dum se nimium querenti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">iactat ultorem, vagus et sinistra</l>

lines.text: labitur ripa Iove non probante u-
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">labitur ripa Iove non probante u-</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">xorius amnis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">audiet civis acuisse ferrum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">quo graves Persae melius perirent,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">audiet pugnas vitio parentum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">rara iuventus.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">quem vocet divum populus ruentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">imperi rebus? prece qua fatigent</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">virgines sanctae minus audientem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">carmina Vestam?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">cui dabit partis scelus expiandi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">Iuppiter? tandem venias precamur</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">nube candentis umeros amictus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">augur Apollo;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">sive tu mavis, Erycina ridens,</l>

lines.text: quam Iocus circum volat et Cupido;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">quam Iocus circum volat et Cupido;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">sive neglectum genus et nepotes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">respicis, auctor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">heu nimis longo satiate ludo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">quem iuvat clamor galeaeque leves</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">acer et Marsi peditis cruentum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">voltus in hostem;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">sive mutata iuvenem figura</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">ales in terris imitaris almae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">filius Maiae, patiens vocari</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">Caesaris ultor:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">serus in caelum redeas diuque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">laetus intersis populo Quirini</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">neve te nostris vitiis iniquum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">ocior aura</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">tollat; hic magnos potius triumphos,</l>

lines.text: hic ames dici pater atque princeps
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">hic ames dici pater atque princeps</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">neu sinas Medos equitare inultos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">te duce, Caesar.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Sic te diva potens Cypri,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">sic fratres Helenae, lucida sidera,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">ventorumque regat pater</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">obstrictis aliis praeter Iapyga,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">navis, quae tibi creditum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">debes Vergilium; finibus Atticis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">reddas incolumem precor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">et serves animae dimidium meae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">illi robur et aes triplex</l>

lines.text: circa pectus erat, qui fragilem truci
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">circa pectus erat, qui fragilem truci</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">conmisit pelago ratem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">primus: nec timuit praecipitem Africum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">decertantem Aquilonibus</l>

lines.text: nec tristis Hyadas nec rabiem Noti,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">nec tristis Hyadas nec rabiem Noti,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">quo non arbiter Hadriae</l>

lines.text: maior, tollere seu ponere volt freta;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">maior, tollere seu ponere volt freta;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">quem mortis timuit gradum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">qui siccis oculis monstra natantia,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">qui vidit mare turbidum et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">infamis scopulos Acroceraunia?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">nequiquam deus abscidit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">prudens oceano dissociabili</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">terras, si tamen inpiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">non tangenda rates transiliunt vada.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">audax omnia perpeti</l>

lines.text: gens humana ruit per vetitum nefas:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">gens humana ruit per vetitum nefas:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">audax Iapeti genus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">ignem fraude mala gentibus intulit;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">post ignem aetheria domo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">subductum macies et nova febrium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">terris incubuit cohors</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">semotique prius tarda necessitas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">Leti corripuit gradum;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">expertus vacuum Daedalus aera</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">pennis non homini datis;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">perrupit Acheronta Herculeus labor.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">nil mortalibus ardui est:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">caelum ipsum petimus stultitia neque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">per nostrum patimur scelus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">iracunda Iovem ponere fulmina.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Solvitur acris hiems grata vice veris et Favoni
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Solvitur acris hiems grata vice veris et Favoni</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">trahuntque siccas machinae carinas</l>

lines.text: ac neque iam stabulis gaudet pecus aut arator igni
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">ac neque iam stabulis gaudet pecus aut arator igni</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">nec prata canis albicant pruinis.</l>

lines.text: iam Cytherea choros ducit Venus imminente luna
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">iam Cytherea choros ducit Venus imminente luna</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">iunctaeque Nymphis Gratiae decentes</l>

lines.text: alterno terram quatiunt pede, dum gravis Cyclopum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">alterno terram quatiunt pede, dum gravis Cyclopum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Volcanus ardens visit officinas.</l>

lines.text: nunc decet aut viridi nitidum caput impedire myrto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">nunc decet aut viridi nitidum caput impedire myrto</l>

lines.text: aut flore, terrae quem ferunt solutae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">aut flore, terrae quem ferunt solutae,</l>

lines.text: nunc et in umbrosis Fauno decet immolare lucis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">nunc et in umbrosis Fauno decet immolare lucis,</l>

lines.text: seu poscat agna sive malit haedo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">seu poscat agna sive malit haedo.</l>

lines.text: pallida Mors aequo pulsat pede pauperum tabernas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">pallida Mors aequo pulsat pede pauperum tabernas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">regumque turris. o beate Sesti,</l>

lines.text: vitae summa brevis spem nos vetat inchoare longam;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">vitae summa brevis spem nos vetat inchoare longam;</l>

lines.text: iam te premet nox fabulaeque Manes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">iam te premet nox fabulaeque Manes</l>

lines.text: et domus exilis Plutonia; quo simul mearis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">et domus exilis Plutonia; quo simul mearis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">nec regna vini sortiere talis</l>

lines.text: nec tenerum Lycidan mirabere, quo calet iuventus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">nec tenerum Lycidan mirabere, quo calet iuventus</l>

lines.text: nunc omnis et mox virgines tepebunt.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">nunc omnis et mox virgines tepebunt.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Quis multa gracilis te puer in rosa
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Quis multa gracilis te puer in rosa</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">perfusus liquidis urget odoribus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">grato, Pyrrha, sub antro?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">cui flavam religas comam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">simplex munditiis? heu quotiens fidem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">mutatosque deos flebit et aspera</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">nigris aequora ventis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">emirabitur insolens</l>

lines.text: qui nunc te fruitur credulus aurea,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">qui nunc te fruitur credulus aurea,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">qui semper vacuam, semper amabilem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">sperat, nescius aurae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">fallacis. miseri, quibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">intemptata nites. me tabula sacer</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">votiva paries indicat uvida</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">suspendisse potenti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">vestimenta maris deo.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Scriberis Vario fortis et hostium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">victor Maeonii carminis alite,</l>

lines.text: quam rem cumque ferox navibus aut equis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">quam rem cumque ferox navibus aut equis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">miles te duce gesserit.</l>

lines.text: nos, Agrippa, neque haec dicere nec gravem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">nos, Agrippa, neque haec dicere nec gravem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">Pelidae stomachum cedere nescii</l>

lines.text: nec cursus duplicis per mare Ulixei
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">nec cursus duplicis per mare Ulixei</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">nec saevam Pelopis domum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">conamur, tenues grandia, dum pudor</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Cum tu, Lydia, Telephi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">cervicem roseam, cerea Telephi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">laudas bracchia, vae, meum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">fervens difficili bile tumet iecur.</l>

lines.text: tum nec mens mihi nec color
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">tum nec mens mihi nec color</l>

lines.text: certa sede manet, umor et in genas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">certa sede manet, umor et in genas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">furtim labitur arguens,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">quam lentis penitus macerer ignibus.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">uror, seu tibi candidos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">turparunt umeros inmodicae mero</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">rixae sive puer furens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">inpressit memorem dente labris notam.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">non, si me satis audias,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">speres perpetuum dulcia barbare</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">laedentem oscula, quae Venus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">quinta parte sui nectaris imbuit.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">felices ter et amplius</l>

lines.text: quos inrupta tenet copula nec malis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">quos inrupta tenet copula nec malis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">divolsus querimoniis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">suprema citius solvet amor die.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: O navis, referent in mare te novi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">O navis, referent in mare te novi</l>

lines.text: fluctus. o quid agis? fortiter occupa
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">fluctus. o quid agis? fortiter occupa</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">portum. nonne vides, ut</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">nudum remigio latus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">et malus celeri saucius Africo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">antemnaeque gemant ac sine funibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">vix durare carinae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">possint imperiosius</l>

lines.text: aequor? non tibi sunt integra lintea,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">aequor? non tibi sunt integra lintea,</l>

lines.text: non di, quos iterum pressa voces malo.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">non di, quos iterum pressa voces malo.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">quamvis Pontica pinus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">silvae filia nobilis,</l>

lines.text: iactes et genus et nomen inutile:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">iactes et genus et nomen inutile:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">nil pictis timidus navita puppibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">fidit. tu, nisi ventis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">debes ludibrium, cave.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">nuper sollicitum quae mihi taedium,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">nunc desiderium curaque non levis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">interfusa nitentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">vites aequora Cycladas.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Pastor cum traheret per freta navibus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Pastor cum traheret per freta navibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">Idaeis Helenen perfidus hospitam,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">ingrato celeres obruit otio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">ventos ut caneret fera</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">Nereus fata. “mala ducis avi domum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">quam multo repetet Graecia milite</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">coniurata tuas rumpere nuptias</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">et regnum Priami vetus.</l>

lines.text: heu heu, quantus equis, quantus adest viris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">heu heu, quantus equis, quantus adest viris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">sudor, quanta moves funera Dardanae</l>

lines.text: genti. iam galeam Pallas et aegida
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">genti. iam galeam Pallas et aegida</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">currusque et rabiem parat.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">nequiquam Veneris praesidio ferox</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">pectes caesariem grataque feminis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">inbelli cithara carmina divides;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">nequiquam thalamo gravis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">hastas et calami spicula Cnosii</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">vitabis strepitumque et celerem sequi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">Aiacem: tamen, heu serus, adulteros</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">crines pulvere collines.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">non Laertiaden, exitium tuae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">genti, non Pylium Nestora respicis?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">urgent inpavidi te Salaminius</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">Teucer, te Sthenelus, sciens</l>

lines.text: pugnae sive opus est imperitare equis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">pugnae sive opus est imperitare equis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">non auriga piger. Merionen quoque</l>

lines.text: nosces. ecce furit, te reperire atrox,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">nosces. ecce furit, te reperire atrox,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">Tydides melior patre:</l>

lines.text: quem tu, cervus uti vallis in altera
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">quem tu, cervus uti vallis in altera</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">visum parte lupum graminis inmemor,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">sublimi fugies mollis anhelitu,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">non hoc pollicitus tuae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">iracunda diem proferet Ilio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">matronisque Phrygum classis Achillei;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">post certas hiemes uret Achaicus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">ignis Iliacas domos.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">O matre pulcra filia pulchrior,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">quem criminosis cumque voles modum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">pones iambis, sive flamma</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">sive mari libet Hadriano.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">non Dindymene, non adytis quatit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">mentem sacerdotum incola Pythius,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">non Liber aeque, non acuta</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">sic geminant Corybantes aera,</l>

lines.text: tristes ut irae, quas neque Noricus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">tristes ut irae, quas neque Noricus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">deterret ensis nec mare naufragum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">nec saevos ignis nec tremendo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">Iuppiter ipse ruens tumultu.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">fertur Prometheus addere principi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">limo coactus particulam undique</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">desectam et insani leonis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">vim stomacho adposuisse nostro.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">irae Thyesten exitio gravi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">stravere et altis urbibus ultimae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">stetere causae, cur perirent</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">funditus inprimeretque muris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">hostile aratrum exercitus insolens.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">conpesce mentem: me quoque pectoris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">temptavit in dulci iuventa</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">fervor et in celeres iambos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">misit furentem. nunc ego mitibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">mutare quaero tristia, dum mihi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">fias recantatis amica</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">opprobriis animumque reddas.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Velox amoenum saepe Lucretilem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">mutat Lycaeo Faunus et igneam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">defendit aestatem capellis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">usque meis pluviosque ventos.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">inpune tutum per nemus arbutos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">quaerunt latentis et thyma deviae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">olentis uxores mariti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">nec viridis metuunt colubras</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">nec Martialis haediliae lupos,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">utcumque dulci, Tyndari, fistula</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">valles et Usticae cubantis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">levia personuere saxa.</l>

lines.text: di me tuentur, dis pietas mea
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">di me tuentur, dis pietas mea</l>

lines.text: et musa cordi est. hic tibi copia
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">et musa cordi est. hic tibi copia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">manabit ad plenum benigno</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">ruris honorum opulenta cornu.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">hic in reducta valle Caniculae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">vitabis aestus et fide Teia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">dices laborantis in uno</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">Penelopen vitreamque Circen;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">hic innocentis pocula Lesbii</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">duces sub umbra nec Semeleius</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">cum Marte confundet Thyoneus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">proelia nec metues protervum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">suspecta Cyrum, ne male dispari</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">incontinentis iniciat manus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">et scindat haerentem coronam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">crinibus inmeritamque vestem.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Nullam, Vare, sacra vite prius severis arborem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Nullam, Vare, sacra vite prius severis arborem</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">circa mite solum Tiburis et moenia Catili;</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">quis post vina gravem militiam aut pauperiem crepat?</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Centaurea monet cum Lapithis rixa super mero</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">debellata, monet Sithoniis non levis Euhius,</l>

lines.text: cum fas atque nefas exiguo fine libidinum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">cum fas atque nefas exiguo fine libidinum</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">discernunt avidi. non ego te, candide Bassareu,</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">invitum quatiam nec variis obsita frondibus</l>

lines.text: sub divum rapiam. saeva tene cum Berecyntio
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">sub divum rapiam. saeva tene cum Berecyntio</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">cornu tympana, quae subsequitur caecus amor sui</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">et tollens vacuum plus nimio gloria verticem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">arcanique fides prodiga, perlucidior vitro.</l>
