lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Mater saeva Cupidinum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">Thebanaeque iubet me Semelae puer</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">et lasciva Licentia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">finitis animum reddere amoribus.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">urit me Glycerae nitor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">splendentis Pario marmore purius,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">urit grata protervitas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">et voltus nimium lubricus adspici.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">in me tota ruens Venus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">Cyprum deseruit nec patitur Scythas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">et versis animosum equis</l>

lines.text: Parthum dicere nec quae nihil attinent.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">Parthum dicere nec quae nihil attinent.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">hic vivum mihi caespitem, hic</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">verbenas, pueri, ponite turaque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">bimi cum patera meri:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">mactata veniet lenior hostia.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Vile potabis modicis Sabinum</l>

lines.text: cantharis, Graeca quod ego ipse testa
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">cantharis, Graeca quod ego ipse testa</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">conditum levi, datus in theatro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">cum tibi plausus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">clare Maecenas eques, ut paterni</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">fluminis ripae simul et iocosa</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">redderet laudes tibi Vaticani</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">montis imago.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">Caecubum et prelo domitam Caleno</l>

lines.text: tu bibes uvam: mea nec Falernae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">tu bibes uvam: mea nec Falernae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">temperant vites neque Formiani</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">pocula colles.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Dianam tenerae dicite virgines,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">intonsum pueri dicite Cynthium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">Latonamque supremo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">dilectam penitus Iovi.</l>

lines.text: vos laetam fluviis et nemorum coma
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">vos laetam fluviis et nemorum coma</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">quaecumque aut gelido prominet Algido</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">nigris aut Erymanthi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">silvis aut viridis Cragi;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">vos Tempe totidem tollite laudibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">natalemque, mares, Delon Apollinis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">insignemque pharetra</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">fraternaque umerum lyra.</l>

lines.text: hic bellum lacrimosum, hic miseram famem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">hic bellum lacrimosum, hic miseram famem</l>

lines.text: pestemque a populo et principe Caesare in
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">pestemque a populo et principe Caesare in</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">Persas atque Britannos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">vestra motus aget prece.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Integer vitae scelerisque purus</l>

lines.text: non eget Mauris iaculis neque arcu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">non eget Mauris iaculis neque arcu</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">nec venenatis gravida sagittis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">Fusce, pharetra,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">sive per Syrtis iter aestuosas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">sive facturus per inhospitalem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">Caucasum vel quae loca fabulosus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">lambit Hydaspes.</l>

lines.text: namque me silva lupus in Sabina,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">namque me silva lupus in Sabina,</l>

lines.text: dum meam canto Lalagen et ultra
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">dum meam canto Lalagen et ultra</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">terminum curis vagor expeditis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">fugit inermem;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">quale portentum neque militaris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">Daunias latis alit aesculetis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">nec Iubae tellus generat, leonum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">arida nutrix.</l>

lines.text: pone me pigris ubi nulla campis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">pone me pigris ubi nulla campis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">arbor aestiva recreatur aura,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">quod latus mundi nebulae malusque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">Iuppiter urget;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">pone sub curru nimium propinqui</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">solis in terra domibus negata:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">dulce ridentem Lalagen amabo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">dulce loquentem.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Vitas hinnuleo me similis, Chloe,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">quaerenti pavidam montibus aviis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">matrem non sine vano</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">aurarum et siluae metu.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">nam seu mobilibus veris inhorruit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">adventus foliis seu virides rubum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">dimovere lacertae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">et corde et genibus tremit.</l>

lines.text: atqui non ego te tigris ut aspera
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">atqui non ego te tigris ut aspera</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">Gaetulusve leo frangere persequor:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">tandem desine matrem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">tempestiva sequi viro.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Quis desiderio sit pudor aut modus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Quis desiderio sit pudor aut modus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">tam cari capitis? praecipe lugubris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">cantus, Melpomene, cui liquidam pater</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">vocem cum cithara dedit.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">ergo Quintilium perpetuus sopor</l>

lines.text: urget? cui Pudor et Iustitiae soror
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">urget? cui Pudor et Iustitiae soror</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">incorrupta Fides nudaque Veritas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">quando ullum inveniet parem?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">multis ille bonis flebilis occidit,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">nulli flebilior quam tibi, Vergili.</l>

lines.text: tu, frustra pius, heu non ita creditum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">tu, frustra pius, heu non ita creditum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">poscis Quintilium deos.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">quid? si Threicio blandius Orpheo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">auditam moderere arboribus fidem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">num vanae redeat sanguis imagini,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">quam virga semel horrida</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">non lenis precibus fata recludere</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">nigro conpulerit Mercurius gregi?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">durum: sed levius fit patientia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">quidquid corrigere est nefas.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Parcius iunctas quatiunt fenestras</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">iactibus crebris iuvenes protervi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">nec tibi somnos adimunt amatque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">ianua limen,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">quae prius multum facilis movebat</l>

lines.text: cardines. audis minus et minus iam:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">cardines. audis minus et minus iam:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">“me tuo longas pereunte noctes,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Lydia, dormis?”</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">invicem moechos anus arrogantis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">flebis in solo levis angiportu</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">Thracio bacchante magis sub inter-</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">lunia vento,</l>

lines.text: cum tibi flagrans amor et libido,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">cum tibi flagrans amor et libido,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">quae solet matres furiare equorum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">saeviet circa iecur ulcerosum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">non sine questu,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">laeta quod pubes hedera virenti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">gaudeat pulla magis atque myrto,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">aridas frondes hiemis sodali</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">dedicet Euro.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Musis amicus tristitiam et metus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">tradam protervis in mare Creticum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">portare ventis, quis sub Arcto</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">rex gelidae metuatur orae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">quid Tiridaten terreat, unice</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">securus. o quae fontibus integris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">gaudes, apricos necte flores,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">necte meo Lamiae coronam,</l>

lines.text: Piplei dulcis. nil sine te mei
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">Piplei dulcis. nil sine te mei</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">prosunt honores: hunc fidibus novis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">hunc Lesbio sacrare plectro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">teque tuasque decet sorores.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Natis in usum laetitiae scyphis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">pugnare Thracum est: tollite barbarum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">morem verecundumque Bacchum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">sanguineis prohibete rixis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">vino et lucernis Medus acinaces</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">immane quantum discrepat: inpium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">lenite clamorem sodales</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">et cubito remanete presso.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">voltis severi me quoque sumere</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">partem Falerni? dicat Opuntiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">frater Megillae, quo beatus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">volnere, qua pereat sagitta.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">cessat voluntas? non alia bibam</l>

lines.text: mercede. quae te cumque domat Venus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">mercede. quae te cumque domat Venus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">non erubescendis adurit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">ignibus ingenuoque semper</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">amore peccas. quidquid habes, age,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">depone tutis auribus. a miser,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">quanta laborabas Charybdi,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">digne puer meliore flamma.</l>

lines.text: quae saga, quis te solvere Thessalis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">quae saga, quis te solvere Thessalis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">magus venenis, quis poterit deus?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">vix inligatum te triformi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">Pegasus expediet Chimaera.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Te maris et terrae numeroque carentis harenae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Te maris et terrae numeroque carentis harenae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">mensorem cohibent, Archyta,</l>

lines.text: pulveris exigui prope litus parva Matinum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">pulveris exigui prope litus parva Matinum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">munera nec quicquam tibi prodest</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">aerias temptasse domos animoque rotundum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">percurrisse polum morituro.</l>

lines.text: occidit et Pelopis genitor, conviva deorum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">occidit et Pelopis genitor, conviva deorum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Tithonusque remotus in auras</l>

lines.text: et Iovis arcanis Minos admissus habentque
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">et Iovis arcanis Minos admissus habentque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">Tartara Panthoiden iterum Orco</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">demissum, quamvis clipeo Troiana refixo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">tempora testatus nihil ultra</l>

lines.text: nervos atque cutem morti concesserat atrae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">nervos atque cutem morti concesserat atrae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">iudice te non sordidus auctor</l>

lines.text: naturae verique. sed omnis una manet nox
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">naturae verique. sed omnis una manet nox</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">et calcanda semel via leti.</l>

lines.text: dant alios Furiae torvo spectacula Marti,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">dant alios Furiae torvo spectacula Marti,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">exitio est avidum mare nautis;</l>

lines.text: mixta senum ac iuvenum densentur funera, nullum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">mixta senum ac iuvenum densentur funera, nullum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">saeva caput Proserpina fugit:</l>

lines.text: me quoque devexi rapidus comes Orionis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">me quoque devexi rapidus comes Orionis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">Illyricis Notus obruit undis.</l>

lines.text: at tu, nauta, vagae ne parce malignus harenae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">at tu, nauta, vagae ne parce malignus harenae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">ossibus et capiti inhumato</l>

lines.text: particulam dare: sic quodcumque minabitur Eurus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">particulam dare: sic quodcumque minabitur Eurus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">fluctibus Hesperiis Venusinae</l>

lines.text: plectantur silvae te sospite multaque merces
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">plectantur silvae te sospite multaque merces</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">unde potest tibi defluat aequo</l>

lines.text: ab Iove Neptunoque sacri custode Tarenti.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">ab Iove Neptunoque sacri custode Tarenti.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">neglegis inmeritis nocituram</l>

lines.text: postmodo te natis fraudem conmittere? fors et
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">postmodo te natis fraudem conmittere? fors et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">debita iura vicesque superbae</l>

lines.text: te maneant ipsum: precibus non linquar inultis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">te maneant ipsum: precibus non linquar inultis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">teque piacula nulla resolvent.</l>

lines.text: quamquam festinas, non est mora longa; licebit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">quamquam festinas, non est mora longa; licebit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">iniecto ter pulvere curras.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Icci, beatis nunc Arabum invides</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">gazis et acrem militiam paras</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">non ante devictis Sabaeae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">regibus horribilique Medo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">nectis catenas? quae tibi virginum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">sponso necato barbara serviet,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">puer quis ex aula capillis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">ad cyathum statuetur unctis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">doctus sagittas tendere Sericas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">arcu paterno? quis neget arduis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">pronos relabi posse rivos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">montibus et Tiberim reverti,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">cum tu coemptos undique nobilis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">libros Panaeti Socraticam et domum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">mutare loricis Hiberis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">pollicitus meliora, tendis?</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">O Venus regina Cnidi Paphique,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">sperne dilectam Cypron et vocantis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">ture te multo Glycerae decoram</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">transfer in aedem.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">fervidus tecum puer et solutis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">Gratiae zonis properentque Nymphae</l>

lines.text: et parum comis sine te Iuventas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">et parum comis sine te Iuventas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Mercuriusque.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Quid dedicatum poscit Apollinem</l>

lines.text: vates? quid orat de patera novum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">vates? quid orat de patera novum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">fundens liquorem? non opimae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">Sardiniae segetes feracis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">non aestuosae grata Calabriae</l>

lines.text: armenta, non aurum aut ebur Indicum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">armenta, non aurum aut ebur Indicum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">non rura, quae Liris quieta</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">mordet aqua taciturnus amnis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">premant Calenam falce quibus dedit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">fortuna vitem, dives ut aureis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">mercator exsiccet culillis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">vina Syra reparata merce,</l>

lines.text: dis carus ipsis, quippe ter et quater
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">dis carus ipsis, quippe ter et quater</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">anno revisens aequor Atlanticum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">inpune. me pascunt olivae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">me cichorea levesque malvae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">frui paratis et valido mihi,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">Latoe, dones et precor integra</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">cum mente nec turpem senectam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">degere nec cithara carentem.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Poscimur. si quid vacui sub umbra
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Poscimur. si quid vacui sub umbra</l>

lines.text: lusimus tecum, quod et hunc in annum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">lusimus tecum, quod et hunc in annum</l>

lines.text: vivat et pluris, age dic Latinum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">vivat et pluris, age dic Latinum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">barbite, carmen,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">Lesbio primum modulate civi,</l>

lines.text: qui ferox bello tamen, inter arma
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">qui ferox bello tamen, inter arma</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">sive iactatam religarat udo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">litore navim,</l>

lines.text: Liberum et Musas Veneremque et illi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">Liberum et Musas Veneremque et illi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">semper haerentem puerum canebat</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">et Lycum nigris oculis nigroque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">crine decorum.</l>

lines.text: o decus Phoebi et dapibus supremi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">o decus Phoebi et dapibus supremi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">grata testudo Iovis, o laborum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">dulce lenimen, mihi cumque salve</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">rite vocanti!</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Albi, ne doleas plus nimio memor
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Albi, ne doleas plus nimio memor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">inmitis Glycerae neu miserabilis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">decantes elegos, cur tibi iunior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">laesa praeniteat fide.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">insignem tenui fronte Lycorida</l>

lines.text: Cyri torret amor, Cyrus in asperam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">Cyri torret amor, Cyrus in asperam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">declinat Pholoen: sed prius Apulis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">iungentur capreae lupis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">quam turpi Pholoe peccet adultero.</l>

lines.text: sic visum Veneri, cui placet inpares
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">sic visum Veneri, cui placet inpares</l>

lines.text: formas atque animos sub iuga aenea
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">formas atque animos sub iuga aenea</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">saevo mittere cum ioco.</l>

lines.text: ipsum me melior cum peteret Venus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">ipsum me melior cum peteret Venus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">grata detinuit compede Myrtale</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">libertina, fretis acrior Hadriae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">curvantis Calabros sinus.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Parcus deorum cultor et infrequens,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">insanientis dum sapientiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">consultus erro, nunc retrorsum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">vela dare atque iterare cursus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">cogor relictos: namque Diespiter,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">igni corusco nubila dividens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">plerumque, per purum tonantis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">egit equos volucremque currum,</l>

lines.text: quo bruta tellus et vaga flumina,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">quo bruta tellus et vaga flumina,</l>

lines.text: quo Styx et invisi horrida Taenari
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">quo Styx et invisi horrida Taenari</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">sedes Atlanteusque finis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">concutitur. valet ima summis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">mutare et insignem attenuat deus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">obscura promens; hinc apicem rapax:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">Fortuna cum stridore acuto</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">sustulit, hic posuisse gaudet.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: O diva, gratum quae regis Antium,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">O diva, gratum quae regis Antium,</l>

lines.text: praesens vel imo tollere de gradu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">praesens vel imo tollere de gradu</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">mortale corpus vel superbos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">vertere funeribus triumphos:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">te pauper ambit sollicita prece</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">ruris colonus, te dominam aequoris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">quicumque Bithyna lacessit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Carpathium pelagus carina;</l>

lines.text: te Dacus asper, te profugi Scythae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">te Dacus asper, te profugi Scythae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">urbesque gentesque et Latium ferox</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">regumque matres barbarorum et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">purpurei metuunt tyranni,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">iniurioso ne pede proruas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">stantem columnam neu populus frequens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">ad arma, cessantis ad arma</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">concitet imperiumque frangat;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">te semper anteit saeva Necessitas,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">clavos trabalis et cuneos manu</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">gestans aena nec severus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">uncus abest liquidumque plumbum;</l>

lines.text: te Spes et albo rara Fides colit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">te Spes et albo rara Fides colit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">velata panno nec comitem abnegat,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">utcumque mutata potentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">veste domos inimica linquis,</l>

lines.text: at volgus infidum et meretrix retro
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">at volgus infidum et meretrix retro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">periura cedit, diffugiunt cadis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">cum faece siccatis amici,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">ferre iugum pariter dolosi:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">serves iturum Caesarem in ultimos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">orbis Britannos et iuvenum recens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">examen Eois timendum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">partibus Oceanoque rubro.</l>

lines.text: heu heu, cicatricum et sceleris pudet
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">heu heu, cicatricum et sceleris pudet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">fratrumque. quid nos dura refugimus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">aetas? quid intactum nefasti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">liquimus? unde manum iuventus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">metu deorum continuit? quibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">pepercit aris? o utinam nova</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">incude diffingas retusum in</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">Massagetas Arabasque ferrum.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Et ture et fidibus iuvat</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">placare et vituli sanguine debito</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">custodes Numidae deos,</l>

lines.text: qui nunc Hesperia sospes ab ultima
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">qui nunc Hesperia sospes ab ultima</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">caris multa sodalibus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">nulli plura tamen dividet oscula</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">quam dulci Lamiae, memor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">actae non alio rege puertiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">mutataeque simul togae.</l>

lines.text: Cressa ne careat pulcra dies nota
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">Cressa ne careat pulcra dies nota</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">neu promptae modus amphorae</l>

lines.text: neu morem in Salium sit requies pedum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">neu morem in Salium sit requies pedum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">neu multi Damalis meri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">Bassum Threicia vincat amystide</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">neu desint epulis rosae</l>

lines.text: neu vivax apium neu breve lilium.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">neu vivax apium neu breve lilium.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">omnes in Damalin putris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">deponent oculos nec Damalis novo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">divelletur adultero</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">lascivis hederis ambitiosior.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Nunc est bibendum, nunc pede libero
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Nunc est bibendum, nunc pede libero</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">pulsanda tellus; nunc Saliaribus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">ornare pulvinar deorum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">tempus erat dapibus, sodales.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">antehac nefas depromere Caecubum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">cellis avitis, dum Capitolio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">regina dementis ruinas,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">funus et imperio parabat</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">contaminato cum grege turpium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">morbo virorum quidlibet inpotens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">sperare fortunaque dulci</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">ebria. sed minuit furorem</l>

lines.text: vix una sospes navis ab ignibus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">vix una sospes navis ab ignibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">mentemque lymphatam Mareotico</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">redegit in veros timores</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">Caesar ab Italia volantem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">remis adurgens, accipiter velut</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">mollis columbas aut leporem citus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">venator in campis nivalis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">Haemoniae, daret ut catenis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">fatale monstrum. quae generosius</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">perire quaerens nec muliebriter</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">expavit ensem nec latentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">classe cita reparavit oras.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">ausa et iacentem visere regiam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">voltu sereno, fortis et asperas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">tractare serpentes, ut atrum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">corpore conbiberet venenum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">deliberata morte ferocior;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">saevis Liburnis scilicet invidens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">privata deduci superbo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">non humilis mulier, triumpho.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Persicos odi, puer, adparatus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">displicent nexae philyra coronae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">mitte sectari, rosa quo locorum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">sera moretur.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">simplici myrto nihil adlabores</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">sedulus curo: neque te ministrum</l>

lines.text: dedecet myrtus neque me sub arta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">dedecet myrtus neque me sub arta</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">vite bibentem.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Motum ex Metello consule civicum</l>

lines.text: bellique causas et vitia et modos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">bellique causas et vitia et modos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">ludumque Fortunae gravisque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">principum amicitias et arma</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">nondum expiatis uncta cruoribus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">periculosae plenum opus aleae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">tractas et incedis per ignis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">suppositos cineri doloso.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">paulum severae musa tragoediae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">desit theatris: mox ubi publicas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">res ordinaris, grande munus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">Cecropio repetes cothurno,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">insigne maestis praesidium reis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">et consulenti, Pollio, curiae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">cui laurus aeternos honores</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">Delmatico peperit triumpho.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">iam nunc minaci murmure cornuum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">perstringis auris, iam litui strepunt,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">iam fulgor armorum fugacis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">terret equos equitumque voltus.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">audire magnos iam videor duces,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">non indecoro pulvere sordidos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">et cuncta terrarum subacta</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">praeter atrocem animum Catonis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">Iuno et deorum quisquis amicior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">Afris inulta cesserat inpotens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">tellure victorum nepotes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">rettulit inferias Iugurthae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">quis non Latino sanguine pinguior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">campus sepulcris inpia proelia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">testatur auditumque Medis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">Hesperiae sonitum ruinae?</l>

lines.text: qui gurges aut quae flumina lugubris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">qui gurges aut quae flumina lugubris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">ignara belli? quod mare Dauniae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">non decoloravere caedes?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">quae caret ora cruore nostro?</l>

lines.text: sed ne relictis, Musa procax, iocis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">sed ne relictis, Musa procax, iocis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">Ceae retractes munera neniae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">mecum Dionaeo sub antro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">quaere modos leviore plectro.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Nullus argento color est avaris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">abdito terris, inimice lamnae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">Crispe Sallusti, nisi temperato</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">splendeat usu.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">vivet extento Proculeius aevo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">notus in fratres animi paterni:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">illum aget penna metuente solvi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Fama superstes.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">latius regnes avidum domando</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">spiritum quam si Libyam remotis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">Gadibus iungas et uterque Poenus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">serviat uni.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">crescit indulgens sibi dirus hydrops</l>

lines.text: nec sitim pellit, nisi causa morbi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">nec sitim pellit, nisi causa morbi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">fugerit venis et aquosus albo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">corpore languor.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">redditum Cyri solio Phraaten</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">dissidens plebi numero beatorum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">eximit Virtus populumque falsis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">dedocet uti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">vocibus, regnum et diadema tutum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">deferens uni propriamque laurum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">quisquis ingentis oculo inretorto</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">spectat acervos.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Aequam memento rebus in arduis</l>

lines.text: servare mentem, non secus in bonis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">servare mentem, non secus in bonis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">ab insolenti temperatam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">laetitia, moriture Delli,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">seu maestus omni tempore vixeris</l>

lines.text: seu te in remoto gramine per dies
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">seu te in remoto gramine per dies</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">festos reclinatum bearis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">interiore nota Falerni.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">quo pinus ingens albaque populus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">umbram hospitalem consociare amant</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">ramis? quid obliquo laborat</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">lympha fugax trepidare rivo?</l>

lines.text: huc vina et unguenta et nimium brevis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">huc vina et unguenta et nimium brevis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">flores amoenae ferre iube rosae,</l>

lines.text: dum res et aetas et sororum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">dum res et aetas et sororum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">fila trium patiuntur atra.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">cedes coemptis saltibus et domo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">villaque, flavos quam Tiberis lavit,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">cedes et exstructis in altum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">divitiis potietur heres.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">divesne prisco natus ab Inacho</l>

lines.text: nil interest an pauper et infima
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">nil interest an pauper et infima</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">de gente sub divo moreris: </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">victima nil miserantis Orci.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">omnes eodem cogimur, omnium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">versatur urna serius ocius</l>

lines.text: sors exitura et nos in aeternum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">sors exitura et nos in aeternum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">exilium inpositura cumbae.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Ne sit ancillae tibi amor pudori,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Ne sit ancillae tibi amor pudori,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">Xanthia Phoceu: prius insolentem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">serva Briseis niveo colore</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">movit Achillem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">movit Aiacem Telamone natum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">forma captivae dominum Tecmessae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">arsit Atrides medio in triumpho</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">virgine rapta,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">barbarae postquam cecidere turmae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">Thessalo victore et ademptus Hector</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">tradidit fessis leviora tolli</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">Pergama Grais.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">nescias an te generum beati</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">Phyllidis flavae decorent parentes:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">regium certe genus, et penatis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">maeret iniquos.</l>

lines.text: crede non illam tibi de scelesta
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">crede non illam tibi de scelesta</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">plebe dilectam neque sic fidelem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">sic lucro aversam potuisse nasci</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">matre pudenda.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">bracchia et voltum teretesque suras</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">integer laudo: fuge suspicari,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">cuius octavum trepidavit aetas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">claudere lustrum.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Nondum subacta ferre iugum valet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">cervice, nondum munia conparis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">aequare nec tauri ruentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">in venerem tolerare pondus;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">circa virentis est animus tuae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">campos iuvencae nunc fluviis gravem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">solantis aestum, nunc in udo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">ludere cum vitulis salicto</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">praegestientis. tolle cupidinem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">inmitis uvae: iam tibi lividos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">distinguet autumnus racemos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">purpureo varius colore.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">iam te sequetur (currit enim ferox</l>

lines.text: aetas et illi quos tibi dempserit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">aetas et illi quos tibi dempserit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">adponet annos), iam proterva</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">fronte petet Lalage maritum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">dilecta, quantum non Pholoe fugax,</l>

lines.text: non Chloris albo sic umero nitens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">non Chloris albo sic umero nitens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">ut pura nocturno renidet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">luna mari, Cnidiusve Gyges,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">quem si puellarum insereres choro,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">mire sagacis falleret hospites</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">discrimen obscurum solutis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">crinibus ambiguoque voltu.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Septimi, Gadis aditure mecum et</l>

lines.text: Cantabrum indoctum iuga ferre nostra et
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">Cantabrum indoctum iuga ferre nostra et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">barbaras Syrtis, ubi Maura semper</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">aestuat unda:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">Tibur Argeo positum colono</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">sit meae sedes utinam senectae,</l>

lines.text: sit modus lasso maris et viarum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">sit modus lasso maris et viarum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">militiaeque.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">unde si Parcae prohibent iniquae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">dulce pellitis ovibus Galaesi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">flumen et regnata petam Laconi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">rura Phalantho</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">ille terrarum mihi praeter omnis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">angulus ridet, ubi non Hymetto</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">mella decedunt viridique certat</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">baca Venafro,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">ver ubi longum tepidasque praebet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">Iuppiter brumas et amicus Aulon</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">fertili Baccho minimum Falernis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">invidet uvis;</l>

lines.text: ille te mecum locus et beatae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">ille te mecum locus et beatae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">postulant arces: ibi tu calentem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">debita sparges lacrima favillam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">vatis amici.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: O saepe mecum tempus in ultimum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">O saepe mecum tempus in ultimum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">deducte Bruto militiae duce,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">quis te redonavit Quiritem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">dis patriis Italoque caelo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">Pompei, meorum prime sodalium,</l>

lines.text: cum quo morantem saepe diem mero
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">cum quo morantem saepe diem mero</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">fregi, coronatus nitentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">malobathro Syrio capillos?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">tecum Philippos et celerem fugam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">sensi relicta non bene parmula,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">cum fracta virtus, et minaces</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">turpe solum tetigere mento;</l>

lines.text: sed me per hostis Mercurius celer
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">sed me per hostis Mercurius celer</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">denso paventem sustulit aere,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">te rursus in bellum resorbens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">unda fretis tulit aestuosis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">ergo obligatam redde Iovi dapem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">longaque fessum militia latus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">depone sub lauru mea nec</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">parce cadis tibi destinatis.</l>

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">fractisque rauci fluctibus Hadriae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">frustra per autumnos nocentem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">corporibus metuemus Austrum:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">visendus ater flumine languido</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">Cocytos errans et Danai genus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">infame damnatusque longi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">Sisyphus Aeolides laboris.</l>

lines.text: linquenda tellus et domus et placens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">linquenda tellus et domus et placens</l>

lines.text: uxor neque harum quas colis arborum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">uxor neque harum quas colis arborum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">te praeter invisas cupressos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">ulla brevem dominum sequetur.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">absumet heres Caecuba dignior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">servata centum clavibus et mero</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">tinguet pavimentum superbo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">pontificum potiore cenis.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Iam pauca aratro iugera regiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">moles relinquent, undique latius</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">extenta visentur Lucrino</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">stagna lacu platanusque caelebs</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">evincet ulmos; tum violaria et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">myrtus et omnis copia narium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">spargent olivetis odorem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">fertilibus domino priori,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">tum spissa ramis laurea fervidos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">excludet ictus. non ita Romuli</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">praescriptum et intonsi Catonis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">auspiciis veterumque norma.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">privatus illis census erat brevis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">commune magnum: nulla decempedis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">metata privatis opacam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">porticus excipiebat arcton</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">nec fortuitum spernere caespitem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">leges sinebant, oppida publico</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">sumptu iubentes et deorum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">templa novo decorare saxo.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Otium divos rogat in patenti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">prensus Aegaeo, simul atra nubes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">condidit lunam neque certa fulgent</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">sidera nautis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">otium bello furiosa Thrace,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">otium Medi pharetra decori,</l>

lines.text: Grosphe, non gemmis neque purpura ve-
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">Grosphe, non gemmis neque purpura ve-</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">nale nec auro.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">non enim gazae neque consularis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">submovet lictor miseros tumultus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">mentis et curas laqueata circum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">tecta volantis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">vivitur parvo bene cui paternum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">splendet in mensa tenui salinum</l>

lines.text: nec levis somnos timor aut cupido
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">nec levis somnos timor aut cupido</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">sordidus aufert.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">quid brevi fortes iaculamur aevo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">multa? quid terras alio calentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">sole mutamus? patriae quis exsul</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">se quoque fugit?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">scandit aeratas vitiosa navis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">Cura nec turmas equitum relinquit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">ocior cervis et agente nimbos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">ocior Euro.</l>

lines.text: laetus in praesens animus quod ultra est
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">laetus in praesens animus quod ultra est</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">oderit curare et amara lento</l>

lines.text: temperet risu: nihil est ab omni
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">temperet risu: nihil est ab omni</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">parte beatum.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">abstulit clarum cita mors Achillem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">longa Tithonum minuit senectus</l>

lines.text: et mihi forsan tibi quod negarit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">et mihi forsan tibi quod negarit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">porriget hora.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">te greges centum Siculaeque circum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">mugiunt vaccae, tibi tollit hinnitum</l>

lines.text: apta quadrigis equa, te bis Afro
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">apta quadrigis equa, te bis Afro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">murice tinctae</l>

lines.text: vestiunt lanae: mihi parva rura et
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">vestiunt lanae: mihi parva rura et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">spiritum Graiae tenuem Camenae</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">Parca non mendax dedit et malignum</l>
