lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Cur me querelis exanimas tuis?</l>

lines.text: nec dis amicum est nec mihi te prius
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">nec dis amicum est nec mihi te prius</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">obire, Maecenas, mearum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">grande decus columenque rerum.</l>

lines.text: a, te meae si partem animae rapit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">a, te meae si partem animae rapit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">maturior vis, quid moror altera,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">nec carus aeque nec superstes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">integer? ille dies utramque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">ducet ruinam. non ego perfidum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">dixi sacramentum ibimus, ibimus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">utcumque praecedes, supremum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">carpere iter comites parati.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">me nec Chimaerae spiritus igneae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">nec si resurgat centimanus Gyas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">divellet umquam: sic potenti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">Iustitiae placitumque Parcis.</l>

lines.text: seu Libra seu me Scorpios adspicit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">seu Libra seu me Scorpios adspicit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">formidolosus pars violentior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">natalis horae seu tyrannus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">Hesperiae Capricornus undae:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">utrumque nostrum incredibili modo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">consentit astrum; te Iovis inpio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">tutela Saturno refulgens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">eripuit volucrisque Fati</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">tardavit alas, cum populus frequens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">laetum theatris ter crepuit sonum;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">me truncus inlapsus cerebro,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">sustulerat, nisi Faunus ictum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">dextra levasset, Mercurialium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">custos virorum. reddere victimas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">aedemque votivam memento;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">nos humilem feriemus agnam.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Non ebur neque aureum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">mea renidet in domo lacunar,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">non trabes Hymettiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">premunt columnas ultima recisas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">Africa neque Attali</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">ignotus heres regiam occupavi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">nec Laconicas mihi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">trahunt honestae purpuras clientae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">at fides et ingeni</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">benigna vena est pauperemque dives</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">me petit: nihil supra</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">deos lacesso nec potentem amicum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">largiora flagito,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">satis beatus unicis Sabinis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">truditur dies die</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">novaeque pergunt interire lunae:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">tu secanda marmora</l>

lines.text: locas sub ipsum funus et sepulcri
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">locas sub ipsum funus et sepulcri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">inmemor struis domos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">marisque Bais obstrepentis urges</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">submovere litora,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">parum locuples continente ripa;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">quid quod usque proximos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">revellis agri terminos et ultra</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">limites clientium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">salis avarus? pellitur paternos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">in sinu ferens deos</l>

lines.text: et uxor et vir sordidosque natos.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">et uxor et vir sordidosque natos.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">nulla certior tamen</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">rapacis Orci fine destinata</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">aula divitem manet</l>

lines.text: erum. quid ultra tendis? aequa tellus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">erum. quid ultra tendis? aequa tellus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">pauperi recluditur</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">regumque pueris nec satelles Orci</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">callidum Promethea</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">revexit auro captus; hic superbum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">Tantalum atque Tantali</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">genus coercet, hic levare functum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">pauperem laboribus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">vocatus atque non vocatus audit.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Bacchum in remotis carmina rupibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">vidi docentem, credite posteri,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">Nymphasque discentis et auris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">capripedum Satyrorum acutas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">euhoe, recenti mens trepidat metu,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">plenoque Bacchi pectore turbidum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">laetatur. euhoe, parce Liber,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">parce gravi metuende thyrso.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">fas pervicacis est mihi Thyiadas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">vinique fontem lactis et uberes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">cantare rivos atque truncis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">lapsa cavis iterare mella;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">fas et beatae coniugis additum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">stellis honorem tectaque Penthei</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">disiecta non leni ruina</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">Thracis et exitium Lycurgi</l>

lines.text: tu flectis amnis, tu mare barbarum,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">tu flectis amnis, tu mare barbarum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">tu separatis uvidus in iugis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">nodo coerces viperino</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">Bistonidum sine fraude crinis.</l>

lines.text: tu, cum parentis regna per arduum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">tu, cum parentis regna per arduum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">cohors gigantum scanderet inpia,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">Rhoetum retorsisti leonis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">unguibus horribilique mala;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">quamquam choreis aptior et iocis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">ludoque dictus non sat idoneus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">pugnae ferebaris; sed idem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">pacis eras mediusque belli.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">te vidit insons Cerberus aureo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">cornu decorum leniter atterens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">caudam et recedentis trilingui</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">ore pedes tetigitque crura.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Non usitata nec tenui ferar</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">penna biformis per liquidum aethera</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">vates neque in terris morabor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">longius invidiaque maior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">urbis relinquam. non ego, pauperum</l>

lines.text: sanguis parentum, non ego, quem vocas.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">sanguis parentum, non ego, quem vocas.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">dilecte Maecenas, obibo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">nec Stygia cohibebor unda.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">iam iam residunt cruribus asperae</l>

lines.text: pelles et album mutor in alitem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">pelles et album mutor in alitem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">superne nascunturque leves</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">per digitos umerosque plumae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">iam Daedaleo notior Icaro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">visam gementis litora Bospori</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">Syrtisque Gaetulas canorus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">ales Hyperboreosque campos.</l>

lines.text: me Colchus et qui dissimulat metum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">me Colchus et qui dissimulat metum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">Marsae cohortis Dacus et ultimi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">noscent Geloni, me peritus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">discet Hiber Rhodanique potor.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">absint inani funere neniae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">luctusque turpes et querimoniae;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">conpesce clamorem ac sepulcri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">mitte supervacuos honores.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Odi profanum volgus et arceo.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">favete linguis: carmina non prius</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">audita Musarum sacerdos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">virginibus puerisque canto.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">regum timendorum in proprios greges,</l>

lines.text: reges in ipsos imperium est Iovis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">reges in ipsos imperium est Iovis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">clari Giganteo triumpho,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">cuncta supercilio moventis.</l>

lines.text: est ut viro vir latius ordinet
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">est ut viro vir latius ordinet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">arbusta sulcis, hic generosior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">descendat in campum petitor,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">moribus hic meliorque fama</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">contendat, illi turba clientium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">sit maior: aequa lege Necessitas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">sortitur insignis et imos,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">omne capax movet urna nomen.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">destrictus ensis cui super inpia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">cervice pendet, non Siculae dapes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">dulcem elaborabunt saporem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">non avium citharaeque cantus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">somnum reducent: somnus agrestium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">lenis virorum non humilis domos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">fastidit umbrosamque ripam,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">non Zephyris agitata Tempe.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">desiderantem quod satis est neque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">tumultuosum sollicitat mare</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">nec saevus Arcturi cadentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">impetus aut orientis Haedi,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">non verberatae grandine vineae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">fundusque mendax arbore nunc aquas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">culpante, nunc torrentia agros</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">sidera, nunc hiemes iniquas.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">contracta pisces aequora sentiunt</l>

lines.text: iactis in altum molibus: huc frequens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">iactis in altum molibus: huc frequens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">caementa demittit redemptor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">cum famulis dominusque terrae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">fastidiosus: sed Timor et Minae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">scandunt eodem, quo dominus, neque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">decedit aerata triremi et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">post equitem sedet atra Cura.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">quodsi dolentem nec Phrygius lapis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">nec purpurarum sidere clarior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">delenit usus nec Falerna</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">vitis Achaemeniumque costum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">cur invidendis postibus et novo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">sublime ritu moliar atrium?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">cur valle permutem Sabina</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">divitias operosiores?</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Angustam amice pauperiem pati</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">robustus acri militia puer</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">condiscat et Parthos ferocis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">vexet eques metuendus hasta</l>

lines.text: vitamque sub divo et trepidis agat
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">vitamque sub divo et trepidis agat</l>

lines.text: in rebus. illum ex moenibus hosticis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">in rebus. illum ex moenibus hosticis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">matrona bellantis tyranni</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">prospiciens et adulta virgo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">suspiret “eheu, ne rudis agminum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">sponsus lacessat regius asperum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">tactu leonem, quem cruenta</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">per medias rapit ira caedes.”</l>

lines.text: dulce et decorum est pro patria mori:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">dulce et decorum est pro patria mori:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">mors et fugacem persequitur virum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">nec parcit inbellis iuventae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">poplitibus timidoque tergo.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">Virtus, repulsae nescia sordidae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">intaminatis fulget honoribus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">nec sumit aut ponit securis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">arbitrio popularis aurae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">Virtus, recludens inmeritis mori</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">caelum, negata temptat iter via</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">coetusque volgaris et udam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">spernit humum fugiente penna.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">est et fideli tuta silentio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">merces: vetabo, qui Cereris sacrum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">volgarit arcanae, sub isdem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">sit trabibus fragilemque mecum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">solvat phaselon; saepe Diespiter</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">neglectus incesto addidit integrum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">raro antecedentem scelestum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">deseruit pede Poena claudo.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Iustum et tenacem propositi virum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">non civium ardor prava iubentium,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">non voltus instantis tyranni</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">mente quatit solida neque Auster,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">dux inquieti turbidus Hadriae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">nec fulminantis magna manus Iovis:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">si fractus inlabatur orbis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">inpavidum ferient ruinae.</l>

lines.text: hac arte Pollux et vagus Hercules
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">hac arte Pollux et vagus Hercules</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">enisus arcis attigit igneas,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">quos inter Augustus recumbens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">purpureo bibet ore nectar,</l>

lines.text: hac te merentem, Bacche pater, tuae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">hac te merentem, Bacche pater, tuae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">vexere tigres indocili iugum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">collo trahentes, hac Quirinus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">Martis equis Acheronta fugit,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">gratum elocuta consiliantibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">Iunone divis: “Ilion, Ilion</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">fatalis incestusque iudex</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">et mulier peregrina vertit</l>

lines.text: in pulverem ex quo destituit deos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">in pulverem  ex quo destituit deos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">mercede pacta Laomedon, mihi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">castaeque damnatum Minervae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">cum populo et duce fraudulento.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">iam nec Lacaenae splendet adulterae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">famosus hospes nec Priami domus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">periura pugnacis Achivos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">Hectoreis opibus refringit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">nostrisque ductum seditionibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">bellum resedit; protinus et gravis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">iras et invisum nepotem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">Troica quem peperit sacerdos,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">Marti redonabo; illum ego lucidas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">inire sedes, discere nectaris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">sucos et adscribi quietis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">ordinibus patiar deorum.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">dum longus inter saeviat Ilion</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">Romamque pontus, qualibet exsules</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">in parte regnanto beati;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">dum Priami Paridisque busto</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">insultet armentum et catulos ferae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">celent inultae, stet Capitolium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">fulgens triumphatisque possit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">Roma ferox dare iura Medis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">horrenda late nomen in ultimas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">extendat oras, qua medius liquor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">secernit Europen ab Afro,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">qua tumidus rigat arva Nilus.</l>

lines.text: aurum inrepertum et sic melius situm,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">aurum inrepertum et sic melius situm,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">cum terra celat, spernere fortior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">quam cogere humanos in usus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">omne sacrum rapiente dextra,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="53">quicumque mundo terminus obstitit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="54">hunc tanget armis, visere gestiens,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="55">qua parte debacchentur ignes,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="56">qua nebulae pluviique rores.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="57">sed bellicosis fata Quiritibus</l>

lines.text: hac lege dico, ne nimium pii
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="58">hac lege dico, ne nimium pii</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="59">rebusque fidentes avitae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="60">tecta velint reparare Troiae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="61">Troiae renascens alite lugubri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="62">fortuna tristi clade iterabitur</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="63">ducente victrices catervas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="64">coniuge me Iovis et sorore.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="65">ter si resurgat murus aeneus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="66">auctore Phoebo, ter pereat meis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="67">excisus Argivis, ter uxor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="68">capta virum puerosque ploret”</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="69">non hoc iocosae conveniet lyrae —</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="70">quo, Musa, tendis? desine pervicax</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="71">referre sermones deorum et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="72">magna modis tenuare parvis.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Descende caelo et dic age tibia
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Descende caelo et dic age tibia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">regina longum Calliope melos,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">seu voce nunc mavis acuta</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">seu fidibus citharave Phoebi.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">auditis? an me ludit amabilis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">insania?  audire et videor pios</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">errare per lucos, amoenae</l>

lines.text: quos et aquae subeunt et aurae.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">quos et aquae subeunt et aurae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">me fabulosae Volture in Apulo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">nutricis extra limina Pulliae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">ludo fatigatumque somno</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">fronde nova puerum palumbes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">texere, mirum quod foret omnibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">quicumque celsae nidum Aceruntiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">saltusque Bantinos et arvum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">pingue tenent humilis Forenti,</l>

lines.text: ut tuto ab atris corpore viperis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">ut tuto ab atris corpore viperis</l>

lines.text: dormirem et ursis, ut premerer sacra
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">dormirem et ursis, ut premerer sacra</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">lauroque conlataque myrto</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">non sine dis animosus infans.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">vester, Camenae, vester in arduos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">tollor Sabinos, seu mihi frigidum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">Praeneste seu Tibur supinum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">seu liquidae placuere Baiae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">vestris amicum fontibus et choris</l>

lines.text: non me Philippis versa acies retro,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">non me Philippis versa acies retro,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">devota non extinxit arbor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">nec Sicula Palinurus unda.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">utcumque mecum vos eritis, libens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">insanientem navita Bosporum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">temptabo et urentis harenas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">litoris Assyrii viator,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">visam Britannos hospitibus feros</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">et laetum equino sanguine Concanum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">visam pharetratos Gelonos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">et Scythicum inviolatus amnem.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">vos Caesarem altum, militia simul</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">fessas cohortes abdidit oppidis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">finire quaerentem labores</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">Pierio recreatis antro.</l>

lines.text: vos lene consilium et datis et dato
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">vos lene consilium et datis et dato</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">gaudetis, almae. scimus, ut inpios</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">Titanas immanemque turbam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">fulmine sustulerit caduco</l>

lines.text: qui terram inertem, qui mare temperat
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">qui terram inertem, qui mare temperat</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">ventosum et urbis regnaque tristia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">divosque mortalisque turmas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">imperio regit unus aequo.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">magnum illa terrorem intulerat Iovi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">fidens iuventus horrida bracchiis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">fratresque tendentes opaco</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">Pelion inposuisse Olympo.</l>

lines.text: sed quid Typhoeus et validus Mimas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="53">sed quid Typhoeus et validus Mimas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="54">aut quid minaci Porphyrion statu,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="55">quid Rhoetus evolsisque truncis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="56">Enceladus iaculator audax</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="57">contra sonantem Palladis aegida</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="58">possent ruentes? hinc avidus stetit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="59">Volcanus, hinc matrona Iuno et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="60">numquam umeris positurus arcum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="61">qui rore puro Castaliae lavit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="62">crinis solutos, qui Lyciae tenet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="63">dumeta natalemque silvam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="64">Delius et Patareus Apollo.</l>

lines.text: vis consili expers mole ruit sua,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="65">vis consili expers mole ruit sua,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="66">vim temperatam di quoque provehunt</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="67">in maius; idem odere viris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="68">omne nefas animo moventis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="69">testis mearum centimanus Gyas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="70">sententiarum, notus et integrae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="71">temptator Orion Dianae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="72">virginea domitus sagitta.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="73">iniecta monstris Terra dolet suis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="74">maeretque partus fulmine luridum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="75">missos ad Orcum; nec peredit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="76">inpositam celer ignis Aetnen</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="77">incontinentis nec Tityi iecur</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="78">reliquit ales, nequitiae additus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="79">custos; amatorem trecentae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="80">Pirithoum cohibent catenae.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Caelo tonantem credidimus Iovem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">regnare; praesens divus habebitur</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">Augustus adiectis Britannis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">imperio gravibusque Persis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">milesne Crassi coniuge barbara</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">turpis maritus vixit et hostium,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">pro curia inversique mores!</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">consenuit socerorum in armis</l>

lines.text: sub rege Medo Marsus et Apulus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">sub rege Medo Marsus et Apulus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">anciliorum et nominis et togae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">oblitus aeternaeque Vestae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">incolumi Iove et urbe Roma?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">hoc caverat mens provida Reguli</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">dissentientis condicionibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">foedis et exemplo trahentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">perniciem veniens in aevum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">si non periret inmiserabilis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">captiva pubes. “signa ego Punicis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">adfixa delubris et arma</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">militibus sine caede” dixit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">“derepta vidi, vidi ego civium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">retorta tergo bracchia libero</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">portasque non clausas et arva</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">Marte coli populata nostro.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">auro repensus scilicet acrior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">miles redibit: flagitio additis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">damnum; neque amissos colores</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">lana refert medicata fuco</l>

lines.text: nec vera virtus, cum semel excidit,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">nec vera virtus, cum semel excidit,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">curat reponi deterioribus.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">si pugnat extricata densis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">cerva plagis, erit ille fortis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">qui perfidis se credidit hostibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">et Marte Poenos proteret altero;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">qui lora restrictis lacertis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">sensit iners timuitque mortem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">hic, unde vitam sumeret inscius,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">pacem duello miscuit. o pudor!</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">o magna Carthago, probrosis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">altior Italiae ruinis!”</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">fertur pudicae coniugis osculum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">parvosque natos ut capitis minor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">ab se removisse et virilem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">torvus humi posuisse voltum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">donec labantis consilio patres</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">firmaret auctor numquam alias dato</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">interque maerentis amicos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">egregius properaret exul.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">atqui sciebat, quae sibi barbarus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">tortor pararet: non aliter tamen</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">dimovit obstantis propinquos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">et populum reditus morantem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="53">quam si clientum longa negotia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="54">diiudicata lite relinqueret</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="55">tendens Venafranos in agros</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="56">aut Lacedaemonium Tarentum.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Delicta maiorum inmeritus lues,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">Romane, donec templa refeceris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">aedisque labentis deorum et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">foeda nigro simulacra fumo.</l>

lines.text: dis te minorem quod geris, imperas:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">dis te minorem quod geris, imperas:</l>

lines.text: hinc omne principium, huc refer exitum:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">hinc omne principium, huc refer exitum:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">di multa neglecti dederunt</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Hesperiae mala luctuosae.</l>

lines.text: iam bis Monaeses et Pacori manus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">iam bis Monaeses et Pacori manus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">inauspicatos contudit impetus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">nostros et adiecisse praedam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">torquibus exiguis renidet.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">paene occupatam seditionibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">delevit urbem Dacus et Aethiops,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">hic classe formidatus, ille</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">missilibus melior sagittis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">fecunda culpae saecula nuptias</l>

lines.text: primum inquinavere et genus et domos:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">primum inquinavere et genus et domos:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">hoc fonte derivata clades</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">in patriam populumque fluxit.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">motus doceri gaudet Ionicos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">matura virgo et fingitur artibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">iam nunc et incestos amores</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">de tenero meditatur ungui.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">mox iuniores quaerit adulteros</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">inter mariti vina neque eligit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">cui donet inpermissa raptim</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">gaudia luminibus remotis,</l>

lines.text: sed iussa coram non sine conscio
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">sed iussa coram non sine conscio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">surgit marito, seu vocat institor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">seu navis Hispanae magister,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">dedecorum pretiosus emptor.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">non his iuventus orta parentibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">infecit aequor sanguine Punico</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">Pyrrhumque et ingentem cecidit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">Antiochum Hannibalemque dirum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">sed rusticorum mascula militum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">proles, Sabellis docta ligonibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">versare glaebas et severae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">matris ad arbitrium recisos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">portare fustis, sol ubi montium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">mutaret umbras et iuga demeret</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">bubus fatigatis amicum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">tempus agens abeunte curru.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">damnosa quid non inminuit dies?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">aetas parentum, peior avis, tulit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">nos nequiores, mox daturos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">progeniem vitiosiorem.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Quid fles, Asterie, quem tibi, candidi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Quid fles, Asterie, quem tibi, candidi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">primo restituent vere Favonii</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">Thyna merce beatum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">constantis iuvenem fide</l>

lines.text: Gygen? ille Notis actus ad Oricum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">Gygen? ille Notis actus ad Oricum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">post insana Caprae sidera frigidas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">noctis non sine multis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">insomnis lacrimis agit.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">atqui sollicitae nuntius hospitae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">suspirare Chloen et miseram tuis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">dicens ignibus uri,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">temptat mille vafer modis:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">ut Proetum mulier perfida credulum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">falsis inpulerit criminibus nimis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">casto Bellerophontae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">maturare necem, refert;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">narrat paene datum Pelea Tartaro,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">Magnessam Hippolyten dum fugit abstinens,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">et peccare docentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">fallax historias movet.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">frustra: nam scopulis surdior Icari</l>

lines.text: voces audit adhuc integer. at tibi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">voces audit adhuc integer. at tibi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">ne vicinus Enipeus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">plus iusto placeat cave;</l>

lines.text: quamvis non alius flectere equum sciens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">quamvis non alius flectere equum sciens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">aeque conspicitur gramine Martio,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">nec quisquam citus aeque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">Tusco denatat alveo.</l>

lines.text: prima nocte domum claude neque in vias
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">prima nocte domum claude neque in vias</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">sub cantu querulae despice tibiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">et te saepe vocanti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">duram difficilis mane.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Martiis caelebs quid agam kalendis,</l>

lines.text: quid velint flores et acerra turis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">quid velint flores et acerra turis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">plena miraris positusque carbo in</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">caespite vivo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">docte sermones utriusque linguae?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">voveram dulcis epulas et album</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">Libero caprum prope funeratus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">arboris ictu.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">hic dies anno redeunte festus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">corticem adstrictum pice dimovebit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">amphorae fumum bibere institutae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">consule Tullo.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">sume, Maecenas, cyathos amici</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">sospitis centum et vigiles lucernas</l>

lines.text: perfer in lucem: procul omnis esto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">perfer in lucem: procul omnis esto</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">clamor et ira.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">mitte civilis super urbe curas:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">occidit Daci Cotisonis agmen,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">Medus infestus sibi luctuosis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">dissidet armis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">servit Hispanae vetus hostis orae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">Cantaber, sera domitus catena,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">iam Scythae laxo meditantur arcu</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">cedere campis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">neglegens, ne qua populus laboret,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">parce privatus nimium cavere et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">dona praesentis cape laetus horae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">linque severa.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">“Donec gratus eram tibi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">nec quisquam potior bracchia candidae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">cervici iuvenis dabat,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">Persarum vigui rege beatior.”</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">“donec non alia magis</l>

lines.text: arsisti neque erat Lydia post Chloen,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">arsisti neque erat Lydia post Chloen,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">multi Lydia nominis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Romana vigui clarior Ilia.”</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">“me nunc Thressa Chloe regit,</l>

lines.text: dulcis docta modos et citharae sciens,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">dulcis docta modos et citharae sciens,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">pro qua non metuam mori,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">si parcent animae fata superstiti”</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">“me torret face mutua</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">Thurini Calais filius Ornyti,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">pro quo bis patiar mori,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">si parcent puero fata superstiti.”</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">“quid si prisca redit Venus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">diductosque iugo cogit aeneo?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">si flava excutitur Chloe</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">reiectaeque patet ianua Lydiae?”</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">“quamquam sidere pulchrior</l>

lines.text: ille est, tu levior cortice et inprobo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">ille est, tu levior cortice et inprobo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">iracundior Hadria:</l>

lines.text: tecum vivere amem, tecum obeam lubens.”
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">tecum vivere amem, tecum obeam lubens.”</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Extremum Tanain si biberes, Lyce,</l>

lines.text: saevo nupta viro, me tamen asperas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">saevo nupta viro, me tamen asperas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">porrectum ante foris obicere incolis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">plorares Aquilonibus</l>

lines.text: audis, quo strepitu ianua, quo nemus

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">inter pulcra satum tecta remugiat</l>

lines.text: ventis et positas ut glaciet nives
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">ventis et positas ut glaciet nives</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">puro numine Iuppiter?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">ingratam Veneri pone superbiam,</l>

lines.text: ne currente retro funis eat rota:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">ne currente retro funis eat rota:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">non te Penelopen difficilem procis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">Tyrrhenus genuit parens.</l>

lines.text: o quamvis neque te munera nec preces
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">o quamvis neque te munera nec preces</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">nec tinctus viola pallor amantium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">nec vir Pieria paelice saucius</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">curvat, supplicibus tuis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">parcas, nec rigida mollior aesculo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">nec Mauris animum mitior anguibus:</l>

lines.text: non hoc semper erit liminis aut aquae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">non hoc semper erit liminis aut aquae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">caelestis patiens latus.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Mercuri, nam te docilis magistro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">movit Amphion lapides canendo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">tuque testudo resonare septem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">callida nervis,</l>

lines.text: nec loquax olim neque grata, nunc et
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">nec loquax olim neque grata, nunc et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">divitum mensis et amica templis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">dic modos, Lyde quibus obstinatas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">adplicet auris,</l>

lines.text: quae velut latis equa trima campis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">quae velut latis equa trima campis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">ludit exsultim metuitque tangi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">nuptiarum expers et adhuc protervo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">cruda marito.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">tu potes tigris comitesque silvas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">ducere et rivos celeres morari;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">cessit immanis tibi blandienti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">ianitor aulae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">Cerberus, quamvis furiale centum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">muniant angues caput eius atque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">spiritus taeter saniesque manet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">ore trilingui;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">quin et Ixion Tityosque voltu</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">risit invito, stetit urna paulum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">sicca, dum grato Danai puellas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">carmine mulces.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">audiat Lyde scelus atque notas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">virginum poenas et inane lymphae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">dolium fundo pereuntis imo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">seraque fata,</l>

lines.text: quae manent culpas etiam sub Orco.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">quae manent culpas etiam sub Orco.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">inpiae, (nam quid potuere maius?)</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">inpiae sponsos potuere duro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">perdere ferro.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33"> una de multis face nuptiali</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">digna periurum fuit in parentem</l>

lines.text: splendide mendax et in omne virgo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">splendide mendax et in omne virgo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">nobilis aevum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">“surge” quae dixit iuveni marito,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">“surge, ne longus tibi somnus unde</l>

lines.text: non times detur; socerum et scelestas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">non times detur; socerum et scelestas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">falle sorores,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41"> quae velut nactae vitulos leaenae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">singulos eheu lacerant: ego illis</l>

lines.text: mollior nec te feriam neque intra
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">mollior nec te feriam neque intra</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">claustra tenebo.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">me pater saevis oneret catenis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">quod viro clemens misero peperci,</l>

lines.text: me vel extremos Numidarum in agros
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">me vel extremos Numidarum in agros</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">classe releget:</l>

lines.text: i pedes quo te rapiunt et aurae,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">i pedes quo te rapiunt et aurae,</l>

lines.text: dum favet nox et Venus, i secundo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">dum favet nox et Venus, i secundo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">omine et nostri memorem sepulcro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">scalpe querelam.”</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Miserarum est neque amori dare ludum neque dulci
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Miserarum est neque amori dare ludum neque dulci</l>

lines.text: mala vino lavere, aut exanimari metuentis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">mala vino lavere, aut exanimari metuentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">patruae verbera linguae.</l>

lines.text: tibi qualum Cythereae puer ales, tibi telas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">tibi qualum Cythereae puer ales, tibi telas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">operosaeque Minervae studium aufert, Neobule,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">Liparaei nitor Hebri,</l>

lines.text: simul unctos Tiberinis umeros lavit in undis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">simul unctos Tiberinis umeros lavit in undis,</l>

lines.text: eques ipso melior Bellerophonte, neque pugno
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">eques ipso melior Bellerophonte, neque pugno</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">neque segni pede victus,</l>

lines.text: catus idem per apertum fugientis agitato
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">catus idem per apertum fugientis agitato</l>

lines.text: grege cervos iaculari et celer arto latitantem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">grege cervos iaculari et celer arto latitantem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">fruticeto excipere aprum.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">O fons Bandusiae splendidior vitro,</l>

lines.text: dulci digne mero non sine floribus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">dulci digne mero non sine floribus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">cras donaberis haedo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">cui frons turgida cornibus</l>

lines.text: primis et venerem et proelia destinat;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">primis et venerem et proelia destinat;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">frustra: nam gelidos inficiet tibi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">rubro sanguine rivos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">lascivi suboles gregis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">te flagrantis atrox hora Caniculae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">nescit tangere, tu frigus amabile</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">fessis vomere tauris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">praebes et pecori vago.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">fies nobilium tu quoque fontium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">me dicente cavis inpositam ilicem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">saxis, unde loquaces</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">lymphae desiliunt tuae.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Herculis ritu modo dictus, o plebs,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Herculis ritu modo dictus, o plebs,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">morte venalem petiisse laurum</l>

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">victor ab ora.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">unico gaudens mulier marito</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">prodeat iustis operata sacris</l>

lines.text: et soror clari ducis et decorae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">et soror clari ducis et decorae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">supplice vitta</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">virginum matres iuvenumque nuper</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">sospitum; vos, o pueri et puellae</l>

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">parcite verbis.</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">hic dies vere mihi festus atras</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">exiget curas ego nec tumultum</l>

lines.text: nec mori per vim metuam tenente
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">nec mori per vim metuam tenente</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">Caesare terras.</l>

lines.text: i pete unguentum, puer, et coronas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">i pete unguentum, puer, et coronas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">et cadum Marsi memorem duelli,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">Spartacum siqua potuit vagantem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">fallere testa.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">dic et argutae properet Neaerae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">murreum nodo cohibere crinem;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">si per invisum mora ianitorem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">fiet, abito.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">lenit albescens animos capillus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">litium et rixae cupidos protervae;</l>

lines.text: non ego hoc ferrem calidus iuventa
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">non ego hoc ferrem calidus iuventa</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">consule Planco.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Uxor pauperis Ibyci,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">tandem nequitiae fige modum tuae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">famosisque laboribus;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">maturo propior desine funeri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">inter ludere virgines</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">et stellis nebulam spargere candidis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">non, siquid Pholoen, satis</l>

lines.text: et te, Chlori, decet: filia rectius
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">et te, Chlori, decet: filia rectius</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">expugnat iuvenum domos,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">pulso Thyias uti concita tympano.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">illam cogit amor Nothi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">lascivae similem ludere capreae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">te lanae prope nobilem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">tonsae Luceriam, non citharae decent</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">nec flos purpureus rosae</l>

lines.text: nec poti, vetulam, faece tenus cadi.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">nec poti, vetulam, faece tenus cadi.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Inclusam Danaen turris aenea</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">robustaeque fores et vigilum canum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">tristes excubiae munierant satis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">nocturnis ab adulteris,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">si non Acrisium virginis abditae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">custodem pavidum Iuppiter et Venus</l>

lines.text: risissent: fore enim tutum iter et patens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">risissent: fore enim tutum iter et patens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">converso in pretium deo.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">aurum per medios ire satellites</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">et perrumpere amat saxa potentius</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">ictu fulmineo: concidit auguris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">Argivi domus ob lucrum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">demersa exitio; diffidit urbium</l>

lines.text: portas vir Macedo et subruit aemulos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">portas vir Macedo et subruit aemulos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">reges muneribus; munera navium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">saevos inlaqueant duces.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">crescentem sequitur cura pecuniam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">maiorumque fames.  iure perhorrui</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">late conspicuum tollere verticem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">Maecenas, equitum decus.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">quanto quisque sibi plura negaverit,</l>

lines.text: ab dis plura feret nil cupientium
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">ab dis plura feret nil cupientium</l>

lines.text: nudus castra peto et transfuga divitum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">nudus castra peto et transfuga divitum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">partis linquere gestio,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">contemptae dominus splendidior rei,</l>

lines.text: quam si quidquid arat inpiger Apulus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">quam si quidquid arat inpiger Apulus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">occultare meis dicerer horreis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">magnas inter opes inops.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">purae rivos aquae silvaque iugerum</l>

lines.text: paucorum et segetis certa fides meae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">paucorum et segetis certa fides meae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">fulgentem imperio fertilis Africae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">fallit sorte beatior.</l>

lines.text: quamquam nec Calabrae mella ferunt apes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">quamquam nec Calabrae mella ferunt apes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">nec Laestrygonia Bacchus in amphora</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">languescit mihi nec pinguia Gallicis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">crescunt vellera pascuis:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">inportuna tamen pauperies abest</l>

lines.text: nec, si plura velim, tu dare deneges.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">nec, si plura velim, tu dare deneges.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">contracto melius parva cupidine</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">vectigalia porrigam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">quam si Mygdoniis regnum Alyattei</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">campis continuem. multa petentibus</l>

lines.text: desunt multa: bene est cui deus obtulit
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">desunt multa: bene est cui deus obtulit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">parca quod satis est manu.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Aeli vetusto nobilis ab Lamo,</l>

lines.text: quando et priores hinc Lamias ferunt
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">quando et priores hinc Lamias ferunt</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">denominatos et nepotum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">per memores genus omne fastos,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">auctore ab illo ducis originem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">qui Formiarum moenia dicitur</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">princeps et innantem Maricae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">litoribus tenuisse Lirim,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">late tyrannus:— cras foliis nemus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">multis et alga litus inutili</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">demissa tempestas ab Euro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">sternet, aquae nisi fallit augur</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">annosa cornix. dum potes, aridum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">conpone lignum: cras genium mero</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">curabis et porco bimenstri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">cum famulis operum solutis.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Faune, Nympharum fugientum amator,</l>

lines.text: per meos finis et aprica rura
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">per meos finis et aprica rura</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">lenis incedas abeasque parvis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">aequus alumnis,</l>

lines.text: si tener pleno cadit haedus anno
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">si tener pleno cadit haedus anno</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">larga nec desunt Veneris sodali</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">vina craterae, vetus ara multo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">fumat odore.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">ludit herboso pecus omne campo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">cum tibi nonae redeunt Decembres,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">festus in pratis vacat otioso</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">cum bove pagus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">inter audacis lupus errat agnos,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">spargit agrestis tibi silva frondes,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">gaudet invisam pepulisse fossor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">ter pede terram.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919
