lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">Codrus pro patria non timidus mori</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">narras et genus Aeaci</l>

lines.text: et pugnata sacro bella sub Ilio:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">et pugnata sacro bella sub Ilio:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">quo Chium pretio cadum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">mercemur, quis aquam temperet ignibus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">quo praebente domum et quota</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Paelignis caream frigoribus, taces.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">da lunae propere novae,</l>

lines.text: da noctis mediae, da, puer, auguris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">da noctis mediae, da, puer, auguris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">Murenae: tribus aut novem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">miscentur cyathis pocula commodis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">qui Musas amat imparis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">ternos ter cyathos attonitus petet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">vates; tris prohibet supra</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">rixarum metuens tangere Gratia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">nudis iuncta sororibus.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">insanire iuvat: cur Berecyntiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">cessant flamina tibiae?</l>

lines.text: cur pendet tacita fistula cum lyra?
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">cur pendet tacita fistula cum lyra?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">parcentis ego dexteras</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">odi: sparge rosas, audiat invidus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">dementem strepitum Lycus</l>

lines.text: et vicina seni non habilis Lyco.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">et vicina seni non habilis Lyco.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">spissa te nitidum coma,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">puro te similem, Telephe, Vespero</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">tempestiva petit Rhode;</l>

lines.text: me lentus Glycerae torret amor meae.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">me lentus Glycerae torret amor meae.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Non vides, quanto moveas periclo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">Pyrrhe, Gaetulae catulos leaenae?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">dura post paulo fugies inaudax</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">proelia raptor,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">cum per obstantis iuvenum catervas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">ibit insignem repetens Nearchum:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">grande certamen, tibi praeda cedat,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">maior an illa.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">interim, dum tu celeres sagittas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">promis, haec dentis acuit timendos,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">arbiter pugnae posuisse nudo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">sub pede palmam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">fertur et leni recreare vento</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">sparsum odoratis umerum capillis,</l>

lines.text: qualis aut Nireus fuit aut aquosa
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">qualis aut Nireus fuit aut aquosa</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">raptus ab Ida.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">O nata mecum consule Manlio,</l>

lines.text: seu tu querellas sive geris iocos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">seu tu querellas sive geris iocos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">seu rixam et insanos amores</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">seu facilem, pia testa, somnum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">quocumque lectum nomine Massicum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">servas, moveri digna bono die,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">descende Corvino iubente</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">promere languidiora vina.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">non ille, quamquam Socraticis madet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">sermonibus, te neglegit horridus:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">narratur et prisci Catonis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">saepe mero caluisse virtus.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">tu lene tormentum ingenio admoves</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">plerumque duro, tu sapientium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">curas et arcanum iocoso</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">consilium retegis Lyaeo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">tu spem reducis mentibus anxiis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">virisque et addis cornua pauperi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">post te neque iratos trementi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">regum apices neque militum arma.</l>

lines.text: te Liber et si laeta aderit Venus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">te Liber et si laeta aderit Venus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">segnesque nodum solvere Gratiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">vivaeque producent lucernae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">dum rediens fugat astra Phoebus.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Montium custos nemorumque, virgo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">quae laborantis utero puellas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">ter vocata audis adimisque leto,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">diva triformis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">imminens villae tua pinus esto,</l>

lines.text: quam per exactos ego laetus annos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">quam per exactos ego laetus annos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">verris obliquum meditantis ictum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">sanguine donem.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Caelo supinas si tuleris manus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">nascente luna, rustica Phidyle,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">si ture placaris et horna</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">fruge Laris avidaque porca:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">nec pestilentem sentiet Africum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">fecunda vitis nec sterilem seges</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">robiginem aut dulces alumni</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">pomifero grave tempus anno.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">nam quae nivali pascitur Algido</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">devota quercus inter et ilices</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">aut crescit Albanis in herbis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">victima, pontificum securis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">cervice tinguet: te nihil attinet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">temptare multa caede bidentium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">parvos coronantem marino</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">rore deos fragilique myrto.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">inmunis aram si tetigit manus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">non sumptuosa blandior hostia,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">mollivit aversos Penatis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">farre pio et saliente mica.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Intactis opulentior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">thesauris Arabum et divitis Indiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">caementis licet occupes</l>

lines.text: terrenum omne tuis et mare publicum:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">terrenum omne tuis et mare publicum:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">si figit adamantinos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">summis verticibus dira Necessitas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">clavos, non animum metu,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">non mortis laqueis expedies caput.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">campestres melius Scythae,</l>

lines.text: quorum plaustra vagas rite trahunt domos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">quorum plaustra vagas rite trahunt domos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">vivunt et rigidi Getae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">inmetata quibus iugera liberas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">fruges et Cererem ferunt</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">nec cultura placet longior annua</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">defunctumque laboribus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">aequali recreat sorte vicarius.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">illic matre carentibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">privignis mulier temperat innocens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">nec dotata regit virum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">coniunx nec nitido fidit adultero;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">dos est magna parentium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">virtus et metuens alterius viri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">certo foedere castitas,</l>

lines.text: et peccare nefas aut pretium est mori.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">et peccare nefas aut pretium est mori.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">o quisquis volet inpias</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">caedis et rabiem tollere civicam,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">si quaeret pater urbium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">subscribi statuis, indomitam audeat</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">refrenare licentiam,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">clarus postgenitis: quatenus, heu nefas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">virtutem incolumem odimus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">sublatam ex oculis quaerimus invidi.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">quid tristes querimoniae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">si non supplicio culpa reciditur,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">quid leges sine moribus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">vanae proficiunt, si neque fervidis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">pars inclusa caloribus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">mundi nec Boreae finitimum latus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">durataeque solo nives</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">mercatorem abigunt, horrida callidi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">vincunt aequora navitae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">magnum pauperies opprobrium iubet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">quidvis et facere et pati</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">virtutisque viam deserit arduae?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">vel nos in Capitolium,</l>

lines.text: quo clamor vocat et turba faventium,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">quo clamor vocat et turba faventium,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">vel nos in mare proximum</l>

lines.text: gemmas et lapides aurum et inutile,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">gemmas et lapides aurum et inutile,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">summi materiem mali,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">mittamus, scelerum si bene paenitet.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">eradenda cupidinis</l>

lines.text: pravi sunt elementa et tenerae nimis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">pravi sunt elementa et tenerae nimis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="53">mentes asperioribus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="54">formandae studiis. nescit equo rudis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="55">haerere ingenuus puer</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="56">venarique timet, ludere doctior,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="57">seu Graeco iubeas trocho</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="58">seu malis vetita legibus alea,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="59">cum periura patris fides</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="60">consortem socium fallat et hospites</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="61">indignoque pecuniam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="62">heredi properet. scilicet inprobae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="63">crescunt divitiae, tamen</l>

lines.text: curtae nescio quid semper abest rei.

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Quo me, Bacche, rapis tui</l>

lines.text: plenum? quae nemora aut quos agor in specus,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">plenum? quae nemora aut quos agor in specus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">velox mente nova? quibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">antris egregii Caesaris audiar</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">aeternum meditans decus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">stellis inserere et consilio Iovis?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">dicam insigne, recens, adhuc</l>

lines.text: indictum ore alio. non secus in iugis

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">exsomnis stupet Euhias</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">Hebrum prospiciens et nive candidam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">Thracen ac pede barbaro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">lustratam Rhodopen, ut mihi devio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">ripas et vacuum nemus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">mirari libet. o Naiadum potens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">Baccharumque valentium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">proceras manibus vertere fraxinos,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">nil parvum aut humili modo,</l>

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">o Lenaee, sequi deum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">cingentem viridi tempora pampino.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Vixi puellis nuper idoneus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">et militavi non sine gloria;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">nunc arma defunctumque bello</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">barbiton hic paries habebit,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">laevum marinae qui Veneris latus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">custodit. hic, hic ponite lucida</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">funalia et vectis et arcus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">oppositis foribus minacis.</l>

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">Memphin carentem Sithonia nive,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">regina, sublimi flagello</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">tange Chloen semel arrogantem.</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Inpios parrae recinentis omen</l>

lines.text: ducat et praegnans canis aut ab agro
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">ducat et praegnans canis aut ab agro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">rava decurrens lupa Lanuvino</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">fetaque volpes;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">rumpat et serpens iter institutum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">si per obliquum similis sagittae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">terruit mannos: ego cui timebo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">providus auspex,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">antequam stantis repetat paludes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">imbrium divina avis imminentium,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">oscinem corvum prece suscitabo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">solis ab ortu.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">sis licet felix, ubicumque mavis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">et memor nostri, Galatea, vivas</l>

lines.text: teque nec laevos vetet ire picus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">teque nec laevos vetet ire picus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">nec vaga cornix.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">sed vides, quanto trepidet tumultu</l>

lines.text: pronus Orion. ego quid sit ater
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">pronus Orion. ego quid sit ater</l>

lines.text: Hadriae novi sinus et quid albus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">Hadriae novi sinus et quid albus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">peccet Iapyx.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">hostium uxores puerique caecos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">sentiant motus orientis Austri et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">aequoris nigri fremitum et trementis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">verbere ripas.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">sic et Europe niveum doloso</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">credidit tauro latus et scatentem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">beluis pontum mediasque fraudes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">palluit audax.</l>

lines.text: nuper in pratis studiosa florum et
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">nuper in pratis studiosa florum et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">debitae Nymphis opifex coronae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">nocte sublustri nihil astra praeter</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">vidit et undas.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">quae simul centum tetigit potentem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">oppidis Creten, “pater, o relictum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">filiae nomen pietasque” dixit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">“victa furore!</l>

lines.text: unde quo veni? levis una mors est
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">unde quo veni? levis una mors est</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">virginum culpae. vigilansne ploro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">turpe conmissum an vitiis carentem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">ludit imago</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">vana, quae porta fugiens eburna</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">somnium ducit? meliusne fluctus</l>

lines.text: ire per longos fuit an recentis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">ire per longos fuit an recentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">carpere flores?</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">siquis infamem mihi nunc iuvencum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">dedat iratae, lacerare ferro et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">frangere enitar modo multum amati</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">cornua monstri.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">inpudens liqui patrios Penates,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">inpudens Orcum moror. o deorum</l>

lines.text: siquis haec audis, utinam inter errem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">siquis haec audis, utinam inter errem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">nuda leones.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="53">antequam turpis macies decentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="54">occupet malas teneraeque sucus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="55">defluat praedae, speciosa quaero</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="56">pascere tigris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="57">“vilis Europe” pater urget absens:</l>

lines.text: “quid mori cessas? potes hac ab orno
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="58">“quid mori cessas?  potes hac ab orno</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="59">pendulum zona bene te secuta</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="60">laedere collum.</l>

lines.text: sive te rupes et acuta leto
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="61">sive te rupes et acuta leto</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="62">saxa delectant, age te procellae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="63">crede veloci, nisi erile mavis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="64">carpere pensum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="65">regius sanguis dominaeque tradi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="66">barbarae paelex.”” aderat querenti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="67">perfidum ridens Venus et remisso</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="68">filius arcu.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="69">mox ubi lusit satis, “abstineto”</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="70">dixit “irarum calidaeque rixae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="71">cum tibi invisus laceranda reddet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="72">cornua taurus.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="73">uxor invicti Iovis esse nescis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="74">mitte singultus, bene ferre magnam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="75">disce fortunam; tua sectus orbis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="76">nomina ducet.”</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Festo quid potius die</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">Neptuni faciam? prome reconditum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">Lyde, strenua Caecubum,</l>

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">tura benignis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="53">te decem tauri totidemque vaccae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="54">me tener solvet vitulus, relicta</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="55">matre qui largis iuvenescit herbis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="56">in mea vota,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="57">fronte curvatos imitatus ignis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="58">tertium lunae referentis ortum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="59">qua notam duxit, niveus videri,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="60">cetera fulvos.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Quem tu, Melpomene, semel</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">nascentem placido lumine videris,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">illum non labor Isthmius</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">clarabit pugilem, non equos inpiger</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">curru ducet Achaico</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">victorem neque res bellica Deliis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">ornatum foliis ducem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">quod regum tumidas contuderit minas,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">ostendet Capitolio:</l>

lines.text: sed quae Tibur aquae fertile praefluunt
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">sed quae Tibur aquae fertile praefluunt</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">et spissae nemorum comae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">fingent Aeolio carmine nobilem.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">Romae principis urbium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">dignatur suboles inter amabilis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">vatum ponere me choros</l>

lines.text: et iam dente minus mordeor invido.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">et iam dente minus mordeor invido.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">o testudinis aureae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">dulcem quae strepitum, Pieri, temperas,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">o mutis quoque piscibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">donatura cycni, si libeat, sonum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">totum muneris hoc tui est,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">quod monstror digito praetereuntium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">Romanae fidicen lyrae:</l>

lines.text: quod spiro et placeo, si placeo, tuum est.
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">quod spiro et placeo, si placeo, tuum est.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Qualem ministrum fulminis alitem,</l>

lines.text: cui rex deorum regnum in avis vagas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">cui rex deorum regnum in avis vagas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">permisit expertus fidelem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">Iuppiter in Ganymede flavo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">olim iuventas et patrius vigor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">nido laborum propulit inscium,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">vernique iam nimbis remotis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">insolitos docuere nisus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">venti paventem, mox in ovilia</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">demisit hostem vividus impetus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">nunc in reluctantis dracones</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">egit amor dapis atque pugnae;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">qualemve laetis caprea pascuis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">intenta fulvae matris ab ubere</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">iam lacte depulsum leonem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">dente novo peritura vidit:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">videre Raetis bella sub Alpibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">Drusum gerentem Vindelici. quibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">mos unde deductus per omne</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">tempus Amazonia securi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">dextras obarmet, quaerere distuli</l>

lines.text: nec scire fas est omnia, sed diu
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">nec scire fas est omnia, sed diu</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">lateque victrices catervae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">consiliis iuvenis revictae</l>

lines.text: sensere, quid mens rite, quid indoles
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">sensere, quid mens rite, quid indoles</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">nutrita faustis sub penetralibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">posset, quid Augusti paternus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">in pueros animus Nerones.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">fortes creantur fortibus et bonis:</l>

lines.text: est in iuvencis, est in equis patrum
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">est in iuvencis, est in equis patrum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">virtus neque inbellem feroces</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">progenerant aquilae columbam.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">doctrina sed vim promovet insitam</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">rectique cultus pectora roborant;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">utcumque defecere mores,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">indecorant bene nata culpae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">quid debeas, o Roma, Neronibus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">testis Metaurum flumen et Hasdrubal</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">devictus et pulcher fugatis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">ille dies Latio tenebris,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">qui primus alma risit adorea,</l>

lines.text: dirus per urbis Afer ut Italas
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">dirus per urbis Afer ut Italas</l>

lines.text: ceu flamma per taedas vel Eurus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">ceu flamma per taedas vel Eurus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">per Siculas equitavit undas.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">post hoc secundis usque laboribus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">Romana pubes crevit et inpio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">vastata Poenorum tumultu</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">fana deos habuere rectos.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">dixitque tandem perfidus Hannibal:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">“cervi, luporum praeda rapacium,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">sectamur ultro quos opimus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">fallere et effugere est triumphus.</l>

lines.text: gens, quae cremato fortis ab Ilio
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="53">gens, quae cremato fortis ab Ilio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="54">iactata Tuscis aequoribus sacra</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="55">natosque maturosque patres</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="56">pertulit Ausonias ad urbis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="57">duris ut ilex tonsa bipennibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="58">nigrae feraci frondis in Algido,</l>

lines.text: per damna, per caedis ab ipso
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="59">per damna, per caedis ab ipso</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="60">ducit opes animumque ferro.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="61">non hydra secto corpore firmior</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="62">vinci dolentem crevit in Herculem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="63">monstrumve submisere Colchi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="64">maius Echioniaeve Thebae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="65">merses profundo, pulchrior evenit;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="66">luctere, multa proruet integrum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="67">cum laude victorem geretque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="68">proelia coniugibus loquenda.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="69">Carthagini iam non ego nuntios</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="70">mittam superbos: occidit, occidit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="71">spes omnis et fortuna nostri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="72">nominis Hasdrubale interempto.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="73">nil Claudiae non perficient manus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="74">quas et benigno numine Iuppiter</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="75">defendit et curae sagaces</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="76">expediunt per acuta belli”.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Divis orte bonis, optume Romulae</l>

lines.text: custos gentis, abes iam nimium diu;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">custos gentis, abes iam nimium diu;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">maturum reditum pollicitus patrum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">sancto concilio redi.</l>

lines.text: lucem redde tuae, dux bone, patriae:
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">lucem redde tuae, dux bone, patriae:</l>

lines.text: instar veris enim voltus ubi tuus
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">instar veris enim voltus ubi tuus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">adfulsit populo, gratior it dies</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">et soles melius nitent.</l>

lines.text: ut mater iuvenem, quem Notus invido
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">ut mater iuvenem, quem Notus invido</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">flatu Carpathii trans maris aequora</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">cunctantem spatio longius annuo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">dulci distinet a domo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">votis ominibusque et precibus vocat</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">curvo nec faciem litore dimovet:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">sic desideriis icta fidelibus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">quaerit patria Caesarem.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">tutus bos etenim rura perambulat,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">nutrit rura Ceres almaque Faustitas,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">pacatum volitant per mare navitae;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">culpari metuit fides,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">nullis polluitur casta domus stupris,</l>

lines.text: mos et lex maculosum edomuit nefas,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">mos et lex maculosum edomuit nefas,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">laudantur simili prole puerperae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">culpam poena premit comes.</l>

lines.text: quis Parthum paveat, quis gelidum Scythen,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">quis Parthum paveat, quis gelidum Scythen,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">quis Germania quos horrida parturit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">fetus incolumi Caesare? quis ferae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">bellum curet Hiberiae?</l>

lines.text: condit quisque diem collibus in suis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">condit quisque diem collibus in suis</l>

lines.text: et vitem viduas ducit ad arbores;
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">et vitem viduas ducit ad arbores;</l>

lines.text: hinc ad vina redit laetus et alteris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">hinc ad vina redit laetus et alteris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">te mensis adhibet deum;</l>

lines.text: te multa prece, te prosequitur mero
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">te multa prece, te prosequitur mero</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">defuso pateris et Laribus tuum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">miscet numen, uti Graecia Castoris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">et magni memor Herculis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">“longas o utinam, dux bone, ferias</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">praestes Hesperiae!” dicimus integro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">sicci mane die, dicimus uvidi,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">cum sol Oceano subest.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Dive, quem proles Niobea magnae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">vindicem linguae Tityosque raptor</l>

lines.text: sensit et Troiae prope victor altae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">sensit et Troiae prope victor altae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">Pthius Achilles,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">ceteris maior, tibi miles inpar,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">filius quamvis Thetidis marinae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">Dardanas turris quateret tremenda</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">cuspide pugnax—</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">ille, mordaci velut icta ferro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">pinus aut inpulsa cupressus Euro,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">procidit late posuitque collum in</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">pulvere Teucro;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">ille non inclusus equo Minervae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">sacra mentito male feriatos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">Troas et laetam Priami choreis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">falleret aulam,</l>

lines.text: sed palam captis gravis, heu nefas, heu,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">sed palam captis gravis, heu nefas, heu,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">nescios fari pueros Achivis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">ureret flammis, etiam latentem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">matris in alvo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">ni tuis victus Venerisque gratae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">vocibus divum pater adnuisset</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">rebus Aeneae potiore ductos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">alite muros.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">doctor argutae fidicen Thaliae</l>

lines.text: Phoebe, qui Xantho lavis amne crinis,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">Phoebe, qui Xantho lavis amne crinis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">Dauniae defende decus Camenae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">levis Agyieu.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">spiritum Phoebus, mihi Phoebus artem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">carminis nomenque dedit poetae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">virginum primae puerique claris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">patribus orti,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">Deliae tutela deae, fugacis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">lyncas et cervos cohibentis arcu,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">Lesbium servate pedem meique</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">pollicis ictum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">rite Latonae puerum canentes,</l>

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">laudes quam “Calabrae Pierides” neque,</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Ne forte credas interitura quae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">longe sonantem natus ad Aufidum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">non ante volgatas per artis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">verba loquor socianda chordis:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">non, si priores Maeonius tenet</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">sedes Homerus, Pindaricae latent</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">Ceaeque et Alcaei minaces</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Stesichorique graves Camenae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">nec siquid olim lusit Anacreon</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">delevit aetas; spirat adhuc amor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">vivuntque conmissi calores</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">Aeoliae fidibus puellae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">non sola comptos arsit adulteri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">crinis et aurum vestibus inlitum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">mirata regalisque cultus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">et comites Helene Lacaena</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">primusve Teucer tela Cydonio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">direxit arcu; non semel Ilios</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">vexata; non pugnavit ingens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">Idomeneus Sthenelusve solus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">dicenda Musis proelia; non ferox</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">Hector vel acer Deiphobus gravis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">excepit ictus pro pudicis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">coniugibus puerisque primus.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">vixere fortes ante Agamemnona</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">multi; sed omnes inlacrimabiles</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">urgentur ignotique longa</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">nocte, carent quia vate sacro.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">paullum sepultae distat inertiae</l>

lines.text: celata virtus. non ego te meis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">celata virtus. non ego te meis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">chartis inornatum silebo,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">totve tuos patiar labores</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33"> inpune, Lolli, carpere lividas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">obliviones. est animus tibi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">rerumque prudens et secundis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">temporibus dubiisque rectus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37"> vindex avarae fraudis et abstinens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">ducentis ad se cuncta pecuniae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">consulque non unius anni,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">sed quotiens bonus atque fidus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">iudex honestum praetulit utili,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">reiecit alto dona nocentium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">voltu, per obstantis catervas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">explicuit sua victor arma.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45"> non possidentem multa vocaveris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">recte beatum; rectius occupat</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">nomen beati qui deorum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">muneribus sapienter uti</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">duramque callet pauperiem pati</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">peiusque leto flagitium timet,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">non ille pro caris amicis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">aut patria timidus perire.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">Phylli, nectendis apium coronis;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">est hederae vis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">multa, qua crinis religata fulges,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">ridet argento domus, ara castis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">vincta verbenis avet immolato</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">spargier agno;</l>

lines.text: cuncta festinat manus, huc et illuc
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">cuncta festinat manus, huc et illuc</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">cursitant mixtae pueris puellae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">sordidum flammae trepidant rotantes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">vertice fumum.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">ut tamen noris, quibus advoceris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">gaudiis: Idus tibi sunt agendae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">qui dies mensem Veneris marinae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">findit Aprilem,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">iure sollemnis mihi sanctiorque</l>

lines.text: paene natali proprio, quod ex hac
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">paene natali proprio, quod ex hac</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">luce Maecenas meus adfluentis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">ordinat annos.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">Telephum, quem tu petis, occupavit</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">non tuae sortis iuvenem puella</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">dives et lasciva tenetque grata</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">compede vinctum.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">terret ambustus Phaethon avaras</l>

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">spes et exemplum grave praebet ales</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">Pegasus terrenum equitem gravatus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">Bellerophontem,</l>

lines.text: semper ut te digna sequare et ultra
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">semper ut te digna sequare et ultra</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">quam licet sperare nefas putando</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">disparem vites. age iam, meorum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">finis amorum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">(non enim posthac alia calebo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">femina) condisce modos, amanda</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">voce quos reddas: minuentur atrae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">carmine curae.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">hiberna nive turgidi.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">nidum ponit, Ityn flebiliter gemens,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">infelix avis et Cecropiae domus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">aeternum opprobrium, quod male barbaras</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">regum est ulta libidines.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">dicunt in tenero gramine pinguium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">custodes ovium carmina fistula</l>

lines.text: delectantque deum, cui pecus et nigri
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">delectantque deum, cui pecus et nigri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">colles Arcadiae placent.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">adduxere sitim tempora, Vergili:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">sed pressum Calibus ducere Liberum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">si gestis, iuvenum nobilium cliens,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">nardo vina merebere.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">nardi parvus onyx eliciet cadum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">qui nunc Sulpiciis adcubat horreis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">spes donare novas largus amaraque</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">curarum eluere efficax.</l>

lines.text: ad quae si properas gaudia, cum tua
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">ad quae si properas gaudia, cum tua</l>

lines.text: velox merce veni: non ego te meis
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">velox merce veni: non ego te meis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">inmunem meditor tinguere poculis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">plena dives ut in domo.</l>

lines.text: verum pone moras et studium lucri
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">verum pone moras et studium lucri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">nigrorumque memor, dum licet, ignium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">misce stultitiam consiliis brevem:</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">dulce est desipere in loco.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.text: Audivere, Lyce, di mea vota, di
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Audivere, Lyce, di mea vota, di</l>

lines.text: audivere, Lyce: fis anus et tamen
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">audivere, Lyce: fis anus et tamen</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">vis formosa videri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">ludisque et bibis inpudens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">et cantu tremulo pota Cupidinem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">lentum sollicitas. ille virentis et</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">doctae psallere Chiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">pulcris excubat in genis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">inportunus enim transvolat aridas</l>

lines.text: quercus et refugit te quia luridi
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">quercus et refugit te quia luridi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">dentes, te quia rugae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">turpant et capitis nives.</l>

lines.text: nec Coae referunt iam tibi purpurae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">nec Coae referunt iam tibi purpurae</l>

lines.text: nec cari lapides tempora, quae semel
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">nec cari lapides tempora, quae semel</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">notis condita fastis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">inclusit volucris dies.</l>

lines.text: quo fugit venus, heu, quove color, decens
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">quo fugit venus, heu, quove color, decens</l>

lines.text: quo motus? quid habes illius, illius,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">quo motus? quid habes illius, illius,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">quae spirabat amores,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">quae me surpuerat mihi</l>

lines.text: felix post Cinaram notaque et artium
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">felix post Cinaram notaque et artium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">gratarum facies? sed Cinarae brevis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">annos fata dederunt,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">servatura diu parem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">cornicis vetulae temporibus Lycen,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">possent ut iuvenes visere fervidi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">multo non sine risu</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">dilapsam in cineres facem.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Quae cura patrum quaeve Quiritium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">plenis honorum muneribus tuas,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">Auguste, virtutes in aevum</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">per titulos memoresque fastos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">aeternet, o, qua sol habitabilis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">inlustrat oras, maxime principum,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">quem legis expertes Latinae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Vindelici didicere nuper</l>

lines.text: quid Marte posses. milite nam tuo
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">quid Marte posses. milite nam tuo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">Drusus Genaunos, inplacidum genus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">Breunosque velocis et arcis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">Alpibus inpositas tremendis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">deiecit acer plus vice simplici;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">maior Neronum mox grave proelium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">conmisit immanisque Raetos</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">auspiciis pepulit secundis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">spectandus in certamine Martio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">devota morti pectora liberae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">quantis fatigaret ruinis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">indomitas prope qualis undas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">exercet Auster Pleiadum choro</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">scindente nubis, inpiger hostium</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">vexare turmas et frementem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">mittere equum medios per ignis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">sic tauriformis volvitur Aufidus,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">qui regna Dauni praefluit Apuli,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">cum saevit horrendamque cultis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">diluviem meditatur agris,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">ut barbarorum Claudius agmina</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">ferrata vasto diruit impetu</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">primosque et extremos metendo</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">stravit humum sine clade victor,</l>

lines.text: te copias, te consilium et tuos
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">te copias, te consilium et tuos</l>

lines.text: praebente divos. nam tibi quo die
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">praebente divos. nam tibi quo die</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">portus Alexandrea supplex</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">et vacuam patefecit aulam,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">Fortuna lustro prospera tertio</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">belli secundos reddidit exitus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">laudemque et optatum peractis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">imperiis decus adrogavit.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">te Cantaber non ante domabilis</l>

lines.text: Medusque et Indus, te profugus Scythes
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">Medusque et Indus, te profugus Scythes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">miratur, o tutela praesens</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">Italiae dominaeque Romae.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">te fontium qui celat origines</l>

lines.text: Nilusque et Hister, te rapidus Tigris,
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">Nilusque et Hister, te rapidus Tigris,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">te beluosus qui remotis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">obstrepit Oceanus Britannis,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">te non paventis funera Galliae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">duraeque tellus audit Hiberiae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">te caede gaudentes Sygambri</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">conpositis venerantur armis.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Phoebus volentem proelia me loqui</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">victas et urbis increpuit lyra,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">ne parva Tyrrhenum per aequor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">vela darem. tua, Caesar, aetas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">fruges et agris rettulit uberes</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">et signa nostro restituit Iovi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">derepta Parthorum superbis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">postibus et vacuum duellis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">Ianum Quirini clausit et ordinem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">rectum evaganti frena licentiae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">iniecit emovitque culpas</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">et veteres revocavit artis,</l>

lines.text: per quas Latinum nomen et Italae
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">per quas Latinum nomen et Italae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">crevere vires famaque et imperi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">porrecta maiestas ad ortus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">solis ab Hesperio cubili.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">custode rerum Caesare non furor</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">civilis aut vis exiget otium,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">non ira, quae procudit ensis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">et miseras inimicat urbis.</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">non qui profundum Danuvium bibunt</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">edicta rumpent Iulia, non Getae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">non Seres infidique Persae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">non Tanain prope flumen orti.</l>

lines.text: nosque et profestis lucibus et sacris
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">nosque et profestis lucibus et sacris</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">inter iocosi munera Liberi</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">cum prole matronisque nostris,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">rite deos prius adprecati,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">virtute functos more patrum duces</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">Lydis remixto carmine tibiis</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">Troiamque et Anchisen et almae</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">progeniem Veneris canemus.</l>

edition: Paul Shorey, Gordon J. Laing; Benj. H. Sanborn and Co., Chicago 1919

lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="1">Phoebe silvarumque potens Diana, </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="2">Lucidum caeli decus, o colendi </l>

lines.text: Semper et culti, date quae precamur
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="3">Semper et culti, date quae precamur </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="4">Tempore sacro, </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="5">Quo Sibyllini monuere versus</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="6">Virgines lectas puerosque castos </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="7">Dis quibus septem placuere colles </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="8">Dicere carmen. </l>

lines.text: Alme Sol, curru nitido diem qui
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="9">Alme Sol, curru nitido diem qui </l>

lines.text: Promis et celas aliusque et idem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="10">Promis et celas aliusque et idem</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="11">Nasceris, possis nihil urbe Roma </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="12">Visere maius ! </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="13">Rite maturos aperire partus </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="14">Lenis, Ilithyia, tuere matres, </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="15">Sive tu Lucina probas vocari</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="16">Seu Genitalis: </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="17">Diva, producas subolem patrumque </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="18">Prosperes decreta super iugandis </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="19">Feminis prolisque novae feraci </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="20">Lege marita,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="21">Certus undenos deciens per annos </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="22">Orbis ut cantus referatque ludos </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="23">Ter die claro totiensque grata </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="24">Nocte frequentes. </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="25">Vosque veraces cecinisse, Parcae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="26">Quod semel dictumst stabilisque rerum </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="27">Terminus servet, bona iam peractis </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="28">Iungite fata. </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="29">Fertilis frugum pecorisque tellus </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="30">Spicea donet Cererem corona;</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="31">Nutriant fetus et aquae salubres </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="32">Et Iovis aurae. </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="33">Condito mitis placidusque telo </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="34">Supplices audi pueros, Apollo; </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="35">Siderum regina bicornis, audi, </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="36">Luna, puellas: </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="37">Roma si vestrumst opus, Iliaeque </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="38">Litus Etruscum tenuere turmae, </l>

lines.text: Iussa pars mutare Lares et urbem
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="39">Iussa pars mutare Lares et urbem </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="40">Sospite cursu,</l>

lines.text: Cui per ardentem sine fraude Troiam
lines.xml: <l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="41">Cui per ardentem sine fraude Troiam </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="42">Castus Aeneas patriae superstes </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="43">Liberum munivit iter, daturus </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="44">Plura relictis: </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="45">Di, probos mores docili iuventae,</l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="46">Di, senectuti placidae quietem, </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="47">Romulae genti date remque prolemque </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="48">Et decus omne. </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="49">Quaeque vos bobus veneratur albis </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="50">Clarus Anchisae Venerisque sanguis, </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="51">Impetret, bellante prior, iacentem </l>
<l xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" n="52">Lenis in hostem. </l>
